tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel pa

shing rta rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ rgya gar skad du/ ma hā san+dhi dh+yā nā bi shrān+ta s+ya bṛt+tī/ ra tha bi shud+dha ka nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta rnam dag ces bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin gdod nas nyer zhi spros dang bral ba'i mkha' dbyings la/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i sku dang ye shes rang bzhin nye bar mdzes pa gang*/ /sna tshogs mdzad pa'i 'od stong 'phro bas gdul bya'i zhing gi rjes 'gro ba/ /rgyal ba sras bcas mkhyen brtse'i nyi ma kun nas dga' ba'i gtsug gis mchod/ /skal bzang skye bo thar pa'i grong khyer du/ /gang gi lam nas nges par 'byung ba'i chos/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul dag las/ /shing rta rnam dag 'grel 'di rab gsal bya/ /de la bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rab 'byams thams cad kyi rtse mo ni/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs yin la/ de'i gnas nges par gang zag gcig gis ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i rim pa nges pa ni/ rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso zhes bya bar gtan la phab pa'i phyir/ 'dir de'i 'grel pas man ngag gi gnas gsal par ston pa las/ re zhig dang por phyag 'tshal ba/ gdod ma'i rang bzhin mkha' mnyam dag pa'i dbyings/ /chos mchog mi g.yo shin tu spros dang bral/ /'od gsal sems nyid byang chub snying po la/ /gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi ni/ sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes g.yo med spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ste/ ngo bo la dbye bsal thams cad dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ stong la go 'byed pa'i nam mkha' lta bu/ gsal la 'grib pa med pa'i nyi zla lta bu/ yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i nor bu lta bu ste/ 'khor 'das gang du'ang ma grub la gang du'ang 'char ba'i gzhi'am dbyings su gnas pa de la/ rig pa rang ngo shes pas gzhi 'pho 'gyur med pa'i don gyis phyag 'tshal ba'o/

/kun byed las/ kye ston pa'i bstan pa kun byed rgyal po khyod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings/ /'khor ba mi spang thugs rje phyogs ris med/ /ston pa kun byed rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /ces pa dang*/ do ha las/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dang*/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*/ / mar la mar ni rjes zhugs ltar/ /rang gi rang rig ye shes ni/ /legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /brtsam par dam bca' ba ni/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa shin tu rmad byung gang*/ /so so rang rig ye shes rtogs bya'i phyir/ /rgyud lung man ngag snying po'i bcud bsdus te/ /ji ltar nyams su blangs bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /de la so so rang gi rig pa'i ye shes ni/ man ngag 'di'i brjod bya yin pas/ de'i don rang gis ji ltar nyams su blangs pa ltar phyi rabs kyi don du brjod par bya ste/ don 'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sdud pa las rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon phyogs bcur gang bzhugs pa/ /kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin/ /zhes so/ /de nyid kyang yum la bstod pa las/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /'dir rdzogs pa chen po ston pa la pha rol tu phyin pas ci bya zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid rdzogs pa chen po yin te/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis rig pa'i ngor btags pa de nyid las byung ba'i phyir te/ kun byed las/ kye nga ni ma bcos ji bzhin snying po la/ /sgro 'dogs skur 'debs don las kun 'das te/

/dus gsum rgyal ba nga las byung bas na/ /rgyal ba'i yum zhes nges par bstan pa yin/ / zhes so/ /de dag gis phyogs dang po bstan bcos brtsam pa la 'jug pa'i rgyu bstan to/ /da ni lus nyid bshad pa la mdo dang*/ rgyas par bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po man ngag gi lus kyi sdom bsdu bas mdor bstan pa ni/ ri rtse nags khrod mtsho gling la sogs pa/ /dus bzhi gnas dang mthun pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rtse gcig mi g.yo zhi ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ /'od gsal spros dang bral ba bsgom par bya/ /gnas dang gang zag nyams su blang bya'i chos/ /rnam gsum rang bzhin dag las 'grub par 'gyur/ /thar pa 'dod pa dag gis dus bzhi yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas 'grub par nges pa yang*/ gang du bsgrub pa'i gnas dang*/ gang gis sgrub pa'i gang zag dang*/ gang bsgrub pa'i chos dang gsum gyis cho ga rdzogs par 'grub pa na rdo rje'i lus rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /da ni de dag gi rim pa rgyas par bshad pa las/ phyogs dang po gang du bsgrub pa'i gnas las/ dus bzhi gnas kyi rim pa bstan pa ni/ dang po gnas ni dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ /dus bzhi'i rnal 'byor dag dang mthun pa ste/ /dbyar ni gangs dang ri rtse la sogs par/ /smyug ma 'od ma 'jag khang la sogs pa/ / bsil sar bsil khang nang du bsgom par bya/ /ston ni nags khrod ri ngogs brag rdzong sogs/ /bsil drod snyoms pa'i gnas dang khang bu ru/ /zas gos spyod lam de dang mthun par bya/ /dgun ni nags khrod brag phug sa khang sogs/ /dma' ba'i gnas dang dro ba'i sa phyogs su/ /zas gos mal cha la sogs rjes mthun bya/ /dpyid ni ri dang nags 'dabs mtsho gling sogs/ / bsil drod snyoms par rjes mthun khang pa ru/ /zas gos spyod lam mthun pa shin tu gces/ /'di dag ni slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dus bzhi rnal 'byor gyi sgrub pa zab mo las byung ba bzhin te/

dbyar ni me'i dus te phyi nang gi 'byung ba kun dro bas gnas dang spyod lam bsil bar bsten cing*/ ston ni rlung gi dus te phyi nang gi 'byung ba kun smin pas dngas gsal phyed pa'i gnas dang spyod lam bstan par bya la/ dgun ni chu'i dus te phyi nang gi 'byung ba kun bsil bas gnas dang spyod lam kun dro ba bsten cing*/ dpyid ni sa'i dus te phyi nang gi 'byung ba kun bskyed par phyogs pas bsil drod snyoms pa'i gnas dang spyod lam gces te/ phyi nang rten 'brel gyi 'khor lo gnyis su gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /dus 'khor las/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de nas gang la shis pa gnas kyi khyad par bstan pa ni/ phyi nang rten 'brel gcig pas de phyir ro/ / yid 'ong dben la nyams dga'i gnas la brten/ /ri rtse shes pa dngas la rgya che bas/ /bying ba gseng ba'i gnas de bskyed rim shis/ /gangs khrod bskyed rim gsal zhing rig pa dngas/ /lhag mthong bsgom pa'i gnas yin bar chad nyung*/ /nags khrod shes pa gnas shing sems gnas skye/ /zhi gnas bsgom pa'i gnas te bde shas che/ /brag ri'i drung ni mi rtag skyo shas che/ / dngas la byin che zhi lhag zung 'brel 'grub/ chu bo'i 'gram ni blo sna thung ba ste/ /nges 'byung skyo shas gsar du skye bar byed/ /dur khrod byin che dngos grub myur ba ste/ /bskyed rdzogs gang la'ang mchog tu shis par gsungs/ /gnas 'di dag kyang las dang po pa dang*/ bar pa dang*/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dag gis ji skad smos pa'i mtshams spyod shes pa bsten na/ lta ba dang sgom pa khyad par can gong 'phel du 'grub ste/ gnas de dag gi yon tan lam 'grub pa'i grogs su shar ba'i phyir ro/ /gang zag rang gi nyams dang sbyar te shes par bya ba'i gnas bsten pa ni/ grong dang tshong dus khang stong shing gcig sogs/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po rgyu ba ni/

/las dang po la g.yeng zhing bar du gcod/ /brtan pa rnams la grogs te mchog tu bsngags/ /lha khang mchod rten rgyal 'gong gnas sa ni/ /sems 'tshubs zhe sdang rtog tshogs skye ba ste/ /sa phug la sogs bsen mo'i gnas rnams su/ / 'dod chags skye zhing bying rgod lhag par che/ /shing gcig la sogs ma mo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /brag dang ri sna dmu btsan the'u rang gnas/ /sems 'tshubs rkyen dang bar chad mang bar 'dod/ /gdol pa klu gnyan sa bdag gnas pa ni/ /mtsho 'gram ne'u gseng nags khrod sman ljongs sogs/ /yid dga' me tog ljon shing brgyan pa ni/ /dang por dga' yang phyis nas bar chad mang*/ /de la 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre ma rungs pa gnas pas/ de dag ni rnal 'byor pa nyams brtan nas spyod pa byed pa'i gnas las/ las dang po pa bsgom pa dang rgyun du gnas bcas nas 'dug tu rung ba ni ma yin pas dor bar bya ba kho na'o/ /rtag tu gnas pa ni lha btsan dang*/ klu sman dang dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i mi ma yin gnas pa'i sar bzang ste/ mthun rkyen 'grub cing 'gal rkyen mi 'byur bar bsrung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnas brtag pa ni/ mdor na gnas khang dang po nyams dga' la/ /'dris shing mi dga' dngos grub chung ba'i gnas/ /dang po 'jigs la mi dga' 'dris shing dga'/ /byin che dngos grub myur la bar chad med/ /de las gzhan kun bar ma phan gnod med/ /'di ni gnad gal po che ste/ zla ba phyed du brtags pas shes par nges so/ /de phyir gnas la brten nas nang gi sems 'gyur zhing*/ dge ba'i sbyor ba 'phel 'grib gnyis yod pas/ /sa gnas brtags pa shin tu gces par gsungs/ /de yang gsang sngags lam rim las/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid la dge sbyor 'phel ba dang mi 'phel ba gnyis gnyis su yod do zhes 'byung ba bzhin no/ /da ni las bzhi gnas kyi rim pa mdor bsdu ba ni/ de yang bsdu na las bzhi'i gnas kyang bzhi/ zhi gnas yid ni lhan gyis 'dzin pa ste/

/ rgyas gnas yid dga' gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan/ / dbang gnas yid 'phrog chags dang ldan pa ste/ /drag gnas sems 'tshubs 'jigs dngangs skye bar byed/ /dbye na rnam grangs dpag med mtha' las 'das/ /'dir ni ting 'dzin zhi ba'i gnas mchog ste/ /gzhan rnams yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /phyi'i yul du snang ba'i gnas rnams kyang phrin las bzhi'i dbyings su gnas pa la/ zhi ba'i gnas ni sems rang bzhin gyis phebs la mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngang gis skye ba'o/ /rgyas pa'i gnas ni sa phyogs gzi brjid che la sems dga' bas g.yeng ba'o/ /dbang gi gnas ni yid la 'dod chags skyed par byed pa'o/ /drag po'i gnas ni 'jigs la bag dro ba ste/ dbyibs zlum po dang*/ gru bzhi dang*/ zla gam dang*/ gru gsum dang*/ kha dog dkar po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ ljang nag shas che ba ste/ de dag kyang zhi ba'i zhi ba la sogs pa'i dbye na bcu drug las/ yang dbye na dpag tu med de spros pas chog go /'dir ni zhi ba'i gnas ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba la brten par gdams pa yin no/ /gnas der bya ba bkod pa'i rim pa ni/ zhi ba'i gnas der bsam gtan khang bu yang*/ /dben la yid 'dzin bkod par 'tshams pa ste/ /phyogs phyed mthongs gsal che ba rab tu shis/ /de la bsam gtan gyi khang bu phyogs phyed la mthongs gsal ba ni ting nge 'dzin ngang gis skye zhing bar chad nyung ba'o/ /khyad par du nyin mtshan gyi dge sbyor tha dad pas de'i gnas bstan pa ni/ /mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor mun khang 'khor ma ste/ /mtho sar 'khor khang nang du lte ba'i tshul/ /byang du sngas gtad mya ngan 'das gzims bzhin/ / nyin mo'i gnas ni snang ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gangs dang chu 'bab nags dang yul la sogs/ /khyams kyi mthongs gsal che zhing nam mkha' yangs/ / sems gsal dngas la bsil drod snyoms par bya/ /phyogs pa'i dus su mun khang 'khor ma bya ba ni/

kha cig nyi ma 'khor lo ltar 'dod kyang 'gro 'dug rab tu mi bde ba'i phyir ro/ / 'dir ni dbus kyi lte ba la 'khor khang nyis rim gyis bskor ba'i sgo shar dang lho dang nub nas 'dzug par bya ste/ lte ba'i phyogs re la 'dom re mda' re byas la/ sgo nub tu byas te/ 'khor khang gi bskor ba nang ma de sgo lhor bstan pa'i phyir 'khor khang shar du sgo bstan pa'i phyogs bzhi'i thad drang nas skar khung bzhi bzhi btod pas dus gzhan du snang ba gsal te/ bskor ba la sogs dgos na'ang nye bar mkho ba yin no/ /nang du yang dag 'jog cing gnas pa'i tshe bkag nas/ byang du sgo dang kha blta bar byas la bsgom par bya'o/ /nyin mo'i gnas ni 'khor khang de dag gi steng du phyed phibs lhor blta ba/ mthong gsal rab tu che bar bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin mchog tu gsal lo/ /der zhi gnas thun mong ba'i gnas bya ba ni/ zhi gnas dus su dben khang ra bas bskor/ /ngang gis sems gnas skye ba'i gnas la shis/ /lhag mthong dus su mthongs gsal dngas pa gces/ /rgyun du yid dga' dus dang mthun par bya/ /dben khang de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi'i gang rung zhig gi cha la/ dbye thang sa yangs phyam gyis 'ong ba'i mtha' shing la sogs pa'i ra bas sked nub tu bskor bas zhi gnas ngang gis skye ba'o/ /sa phyogs de'i mtho sar khri chung du rgyang ring po mthong sa la 'dug pas lhag mthong ngang gis skye ba yin no/ /zhi lhag skye ba'i sa phyogs bstan pa ni/ nags rong la sogs dma' zhing 'thibs pa ni/ /zhi gnas gnas yin gangs sogs mtho sa nyid/ /lhag mthong gnas yin bye brag shes par gces/ /phyogs gang zhig gnas la shing nags dang brag ri skal la sogs pa ste yid nang du gnas pa'i phyogs rnams zhi gnas kyi don bsgom par shis la/ phyogs mtho zhing rig pa dngas yangs phyed pa thams cad lhag mthong gi gnas su shes par bya'o/ /da ni ji skad bshad pa'i gnas la blang dor shes pas don bsdu ba ni/

mdor na sa phyogs dang ni dben khang nyid/ /gang du nges 'byung skyo shas blo sna thung*/ /ting 'dzin 'phel bas dge la sbyor ba'i gnas/ /snying po byang chub gnas dang mtshungs pas bsten/ /gang du gnas pas dge 'grib nyon mongs 'phel/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi tshe 'di'i dbang gyur na/ /las ngan bdud kyi gnas te mkhas pas spang*/ /'di dag rang byung pad+mas gsungs de'i phyir/ /thar pa 'dod pa dag gis shes par bya/ /de la phyogs dang gnas khang gang du dge ba'i chos gong du 'phel zhing*/ dad pa dang nges 'byung khyad par can skye ba de ni snying po byang chub kyi gnas dang 'dra bas bstan par bya la/ gang du rtsod pa dang nyon mongs pa 'phel zhing tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng dang 'du 'dzi 'phel ba de las ngan bdud kyi gnas su shes pas spang bar bya ste/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis man ngag lta ba'i rdzong phreng du/ chos byed pa la gnas kyang gal che bas gang du dge ba dang ting nge 'dzin dam pa grub na de bas lhag pa gzhan du mi rnyed pas bstan pa la gdams pa'o/ /gang du rtsod pa dang mi dge ba 'phel na thar pa'i lam la bar du gcod pas spang ba la 'bad do zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /rang bzhin nye bar zhi ba'i sa phyogs su/ /chu gtsang dka' thub dpal gyis nyer 'tsho zhing*/ /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi kun spangs nas/ /ting 'dzin zab mo'i chos nyid bsgom par shog

/sna tshogs 'char ba'i sdug bsngal kun la gnas/ /'khor ba'i grong khyer ra ba kun spangs te/ /thar pa zhi ba byang chub dam pa'i gnas/ /mya ngan 'das tshal bde ba thob par shog /deng sang 'gro la bdag 'dras phan pa med/ /dus ngan 'khor dang 'jig rten snang ba dang*/ /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi kun spangs te/ /sbas yul rin chen sgo bzhi 'byed par shog /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel ba shing rta rnam dag las/ ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i sa phyogs bstan pa ste rdo rje'i gnas dang po'o// // da ni gang gis bsgom pa'i gang zag bstan pa las/ mtshams bcad rgya dang ldan pa snod kyi 'jig rten bshad pa ni/ gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i gang zag kyang*/ /dad brtson nges 'byung skyo shas dang ldan zhing*/ /'khor bas skyo la thar pa don du gnyer/ /tshe 'di blos btang phyi ma byang chub 'dod/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi rgyang bsrings nyon mongs chung*/ khong yangs spro ring dag snang mos gus che/ /bstan la sri zhur ldan pa de dag gis/ /thar pa'i mchog ste de nyid bsgrub par bya'o/ /de la dad brtson nges 'byung dang ldan pa ni/ chos kyi zhing sa dang 'dra bas med pa'i thabs med/ 'khor bar skyo shas dang ldan pa ni chos kyi 'jug sgo yin pas thar lam snyag pa la dgos/ zhi bde don gnyer dang ldan pa ni byang chub kyi sa bon dang 'dra/ tshe 'di blos btang gi zhen log ni 'khor ba las nges par 'byin pa'i thabs su 'gyur/ gtan gyi byang chub 'dod pa ni rkyen gsum gyi chu lud dang 'dra/ 'du 'dzi nyon mongs las dben pa ni 'gal rkyen rang log gi gdams ngag tu shar/ dag snang mos gus dang ldan pa ni dge ba'i lo thog gong 'phel gyi rgyu rkyen lhun gyis grub/ blo brtan sri zhu dang ldan pa ni thar lam gyi 'bras bu myur du smin par byed pas na snod kyi mchog tu shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang kun byed las/ dad dang dam tshig brtson 'grus che ba dang*/

/snying rje yi rang skyo dang yid ldog med/ /lus dang bu dang chung ma bran dang 'khor/ /gang la'ang ma chags dad dang dga' bas 'bul/ /'di dag dad dang dam tshig rgya yin pas/ /snying po'i don dang ldan pa sbyin par bya/ /zhes so/ /zhar la spang bya'i snod kyang de nyid las/ /snod min log pa'i gang zag bstan pa ni/ /grags dang 'jig rten chos la dga' ba dang*/ /nga rgyal dam pa mi bkur yid thung ldog /'phyar zhing rdzas dang dad par mi ldan te/ /rang tshod nyams len btsan thabs 'dod pa dang*/ /bstan pa yongs la 'phel zhing mi mthun zhing*/ /sgro skur bdag gzhan gnod sems bsgom pa ste/ /'di la mi bstan mchog tu gsang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /snod dang ldan pas ji ltar bya ba'i chos bstan pa ni/ /dam pa'i bla ma rab tu mnyes byas te/ /thos bsam sgom pas rang gi sems sbyangs shing*/ /khyad par snyan brgyud snying po'i man ngag la/ /brtson la rgyun ring sgrub pas nyin mtshan 'da'/ /tha mal phyogs su skad cig ma yengs par/ /gang zag snying po'i don la nan tan bya/ /de la thar pa'i sgor bla ma dam pas 'dzud pa'i phyir/ dngos grub 'dod pas bla ma mnyes par byas la/ thos bsam sgom pa dang bstun rgyud snying por sgrub pas ma yengs par nan tan bya ste/ dpal 'byung bzhi zad pa'i rgyud las/ dngos grub 'dod pa'i dad pa can/ /dngos grub bla ma mnyes las 'byung*/ /de bas bdog pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma mchod la yang dag brtson/ /zhes so/ /de nas thar lam gyi gzhi 'dings pa ni/ nyan thos byang chub sems dang rig pa 'dzin/ /sdom pa gsum po dag dang ma 'gal bar/ /rang rgyud sdom zhing gzhan phan ci 'grub dang*/ /cir snang thar pa'i lam du bsgyur bar bya/ /de la gang nas bsgrubs kyang sdom pa gsum la bslab ste/ nyan thos kyi byang chub 'dod pas so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la gnas pa dang*/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas grangs med gsum la sogs pa na 'dod pas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la bslab pa dang*/

tshe gcig la sogs par myur du sangs rgyas 'dod pas gsang sngags kyi sdom pa la gnas pa ste/ de dag kyang yon tan gyi rdzas yar ldan du 'du zhing ming gi ldog pa tha dad du gnas pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims 'di gsum rten du gsungs te/ klu sgrub kyis/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /de la spyir rnam grol gyi byang chub lam du byed pa la sdom pa thob dgos/ sdom pas ma bsdams pa'i dge ba thams cad bar ma'i dge ba ste/ 'khor ba'i gnas las 'da' mi nus so/ /de la so thar gyi sdom pa lam ma nor zhing phun sum tshogs par bsgrubs na nyan rang gi byang chub thob pas 'khor bar mi 'khyam/ byang sems kyi sdom pas grangs med gsum na sangs rgyas/ sngags kyi sdom pas tshe gcig na sangs rgya'o/ / sdom pa gsum yang bcas pa'i ltung ba yin pas/ sdom pa med pa la bsod nams dang ltung ba gnyis ka med/ zhing med na ston thog dang sad ser gang yang mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de la sdom pa gsum gyi go don bzhag na/ sems nyon mongs mi dge bas ma sbags par sdom pas so thar/ dge ba rgyun chags kyi gzhan don byed pas byang sems/ rang gzhan lha dang gzhal med khang du gsal bas don gnyis lhun grub tu byed cing 'dod yon lam du bsgyur ba gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa'o/ /de dag kyang gnod pa gzhi bcas las log pa/ phan pa bsgrub pa/ dag mnyam dkyil 'khor gcig gi ngang las mi 'da' bar spyod pa'o/ /gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ji ltar bsrung ba la/ kha cig sna tshogs lam sna zin gyi bar so thar bsrung*/ de nas sbyor lam drod ma skyes kyi bar byang sems bsrung*/ /de nas sngags 'ba' zhig bsrung zer ba mi 'thad de/ rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor pa la las dang po pa'i dus nas sdom pa sum ldan du byas nas lam bsgom ste/ las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/

/sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /zhes pas gnod do/ /kha cig gnas 'gyur du bsrung zer te/ zangs rdo bzhu ba la zangs/ rag rdo blugs na ra gan/ zha ne blugs na 'khar bar 'gro ba bzhin/ gang ma thob na 'og ma gnas 'gyur te/ sngags gcig pu bsrungs bas chog zer ba mi 'thad de/ dam pa dang po'i rgyud las/ khyad du gsod pa ni rang bzhin zhes 'og ma khyad du gsod na ltung bar gsung zhing*/ sdom pa thams cad bsrung bar bshad pas gnod do/ /la la bag la zhar 'dod pa'ang mi 'dod de/ yar zha'am mar zha ste sdom gsum mtshan nyid so sor 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzas ldog thams cad gcig par 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ dang po rgyu tshogs gcig las skyes pa/ bar du 'gal bar mi gnas pa/ tha ma sgrub sde gcig pa ste chos gsum tshang bas rdzas ldog dang snga phyi thams cad du gcig pa med do/ /la la gtong thob tu 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ /gong ma thob pas 'og ma gtong bar bshad pa gang na'ang med do/ 'o na gang zhe na/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la sum ldan du bsrung ba la/ rang ldog ma 'dres dgag dgos yongs rdzogs/ ngo bo gnas 'gyur/ yon tan yar ldan/ sdom gsum gnad kyis mi 'gal/ dus skabs kyi gtso bor gang 'gyur bar bya ba dang drug go /dang po rang ldog ma 'dres te/ mtshan nyid so sor 'dzin no/ /dgag dgos yongs rdzogs ni thams cad log la mkhar rtsegs zer ba bzhin/ sdom pa gsum kas rgyud gcig po de'i dge ba sdom par gcig ste/ 'dul ba lung las/ chos gang zhig dngos dang brgyud nas kun tu 'dod chags pa'i rgyur 'gyur gyi/ kun tu 'dod chags dang bral par mi 'gyur ba 'di ni chos ma yin/ 'dul ba ma yin/ ston pa'i bstan pa ma yin par shes par gyis shig /chos gang zhig dngos dang brgyud nas kun tu 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rgyur 'gyur gyi/ kun tu 'dod chags pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur ba 'di ni chos yin/

'dul ba yin/ ston pa'i bstan pa yin par shes par gyis shig /de bzhin du zhe sdang la sogs pa'i bar mang du gsungs so/ /de'ang tshangs spyod la gnas pa'i dge slong dang*/ dbang gsum pa'i lam gyi rnal 'byor pa gnyis gnad gcig ste/ nus pa yod bzhin mi spyod pas 'dod pa'i dri mas ma gos pa dang*/ spyad bzhin dri mas ma gos pa gnyis ka'ang nyon mongs pa de nyid la brten nas sdom pa rdzogs par byed pa'i dgag dgos gnad gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa thams cad du mi spyod pa nyid gtso bo yin na ma ning dang bu chung la sdom pa lhag par skye bar rigs so/ /yang so thar dang dbang gsum pa dngos 'gal du gnas pa yin na sngags kyi rten khyim pa kho nar 'ong ba rigs pa la/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ rten gsum las ni dge slong mchog /ces pa dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ rigs kyi bu yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi ma legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba las rab tu byung ba/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa la gnas pa gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yid kyis sngar brten nam/ brten par spro'am zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /brtag gnyis las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa dang*/ /e waṃ rnam par rab tu gnas/ /e waṃ rnam pa'i bde chen po/ /dbang las yang dag shes par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'dod chags me yis tshig pa la/ /'dod chags nyid kyis grol bar 'gyur/ /ces pa dang*/ 'jam dpal las/ stong pa nyid dga' 'dod chags blo/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags sogs spangs pa/ /zhes so/ mdor na so thar gyis spangs/ byang sems kyis sbyangs/ sngags kyis lam du byed pa gsum yang*/ nyon mongs rang mtshan pa spong bar gcig ste/ dper na dug spong*/ sman gyi sbyong*/ sngags kyis btab ste za ba gsum dug rang mtshan pa spong ba dang*/ dug gis mi 'chi ba'i dgos pa bsgrub par gcig pa bzhin no/ /ltung ba nang 'dzom ni sdig to mi dge ba'i phyogs kyi ltung ba rnams so thar bzhin bsrung*/

'dod pas dben pa'i ltung ba rnams gong ma ltar bsrung*/ 'jig rten ma dad pa'i phyogs gnyis kar bkag pa rnams thams cad du 'bad de bsrung bar bya'o/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dge slong gi spyod pa kha na ma tho ba med cing*/ dus tshod dang 'brel bar byed dgos pas/ nyams myong ma skyes kyi bar du thun mong gi sdom pa gtso bor bsrung*/ nyams myong skyes pa dang spyod pa phyi nang gnyis su phye la/ gsang spyod kyi dus su dbang tshogs 'khor bsnyen sgrub gnyis/ rang gzhan byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus bzhir/ sngags kyi sdom pa gtso bor nyams su blangs pas/ 'og ma gnyis kyi'ang dgag dgos yar ldan du 'gro/ dbang gsum pa lta bu la'ang rang rgyud kyis chags pa dang ma bral na sngags kyi lam du mi 'gro la/ thig le 'dzag med du brtan/ tha mal sgo gsum 'dzin pa dang bral tsam na/ mi tshangs spyod kyi ltung ba gzhi med de/ dgag cha 'dod chags rang mtshan pa log pa'i phyir ro/ /gser dang rdo la khyad par med na gser la reg pas ltung ba med pa bzhin no/ /'di ni dngos po gtso bor ltung ba yin pas pags rim 'das pas ltung ba 'byung ngo zhe na/ de ni thabs la mi mkhas shing shes rab med pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ yang dag par na dngos po dang bsam pa khyad par med cing dbyer med pas thabs shes rab khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir nyes pa med de/ sngags med pa'i dug gis 'chi yang*/ sngags dang ldan pa la nyes pa med pa lta bu ste/ gsang snying las/ sgyu mar shes pa mig yor tshul/ /sbyor sgrol bya ba kun byas kyang*/ /rdul cha tsam yang gos pa med/ / ces so/ /des na nyan thos kyi dge slong la de kho na nyid ltar yin la/ sdom pa gsum yar ldan gyi gang zag la zil gnon du log /dgos pa yar ldan du rdzogs so/ /gzhan yang nyan thos kyi ltung ba bskyed pa'i rnam gzhag gi rgyu tshogs kyang sngags kyi dge slong thabs khyad par can la spyod dus ma tshang ste/

bdag nyid dge slong yul mi/ dngos zag byed la sogs dag /lhar gsal ba dang*/ rdo rje dang pad+mar shes pa la sogs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na lam sgron las/ gsang ba shes rab dbang bskur ni/ /tshangs par spyod pas blang mi bya/ /zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ de dag ni blo chung ba rnams la dgongs te/ dam pa dang po'i rgyud las/ drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta can lta bu blo chung zhing don zab mo ring du spang bar 'gyur ba rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ thog mar de skad brjod pas sngags la 'jug pa'i rgyur gsungs kyi/ rang bzhin du sngags kyi dge slong dbang bzhi ma rdzogs na sangs rgyas mi thob pas/ thams cad rdzogs par thob cing lam yang thabs grol gnyis la brten dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gsang ba shes rab tshangs spyod kyis mi blang zhes pa yang blo chung ba dag grol du 'dzin pa'i gang zag gis mi blang zhes dus dang por len pa bkag /thams cad nas thams cad du ma yin no/ /de yang sngon jo bo bod du byon dus btsun pa rnams spyod pa cung zad lhod pa dgag pa la dgongs kyi/ gnod pa'i tshad la dge slong kho na sngags kyi rten mchog tu bshad pas shes so/ /gnad kyis mi 'gal ba ni/ gsum pa'i lam lta bu dang sbyar na/ lus sems zhu bde'i nyams kyis rgyas/ rang rgyud kyi chags pa dag /thig le 'dzag med du brtan/ bud med mthong yang chags pa mi skye na gsum pa'i lam bsgom yang*/ so thar gyi sdom pa yar ldan du rdzogs te/ gsang snying las/ bla med mchog gi dam tshig tu/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis tshul khrims dang*/ /ji snyed sdom pa bsam yas kun/ /ma lus kun 'dus rnam par dag / ces pa dang*/ sa ra has/ mda' mkhan ma phyag rgyar bzhes pa'i rjes la/ kha rtsang phan chad bram ze yin/ kha rtsang phan chad dge slong min/ /de ring tshun chad dge slong yin/ /he ru ka pa dge slong mchog /ces gsungs nas/ de'i rjes la klu sgrub kyi mkhan po mdzad do/

/gzhan yang chang dang phyi dro'i kha zas glu gar la sogs 'dod yon spyod pa rnams/ tshogs gnyis rdzags shing sgrib gnyis spong pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur dus sngags su spyod la/ gzhan du 'dor bas don gcig ste/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ thabs chen rnams dang ldan pa la/ /nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur/ /ces bshad pa bzhin no/ / sdom pa gsum gar skyon dang nyes pa bskyed pa rnams bkag cing sdom la/ yon tan bskyed pa rnams bkag pa gang na'ang med do/ /yang kun rdzob smon 'jug gi sems bde ba chen por snang ba thams cad shar dus byang chub sems kyi sdom pa thams cad rdzogs te/ kye rdo rje las/ kun rdzob don dam gzugs can kyi/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya/ / kun rdzob kun+da lta bu la/ /don dam bde ba'i gzugs can no/ /zhes so/ /ngo bo gnas 'gyur ni/ gsang ba cod pan las/ dper na rdo las zangs su 'gyur/ /zangs las gser gyi rnam pa ste/ /zangs kyi dus na rdo med cing*/ / gser du gyur pas zangs mi snang*/ /rig 'dzin nang gi dge slong la/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /gnyis po gnas pa nyid du ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gsungs so/ /zhes pas rigs 'dzin sngags kyi rang dus na so thar dang byang sems zhes rdzas gzhan tha dad pa med do/ /sngags kyi sdom pa rdzas su ngo bo gnas 'gyur du yod pa'i phyir la/ ldog pa ma 'dres par yod de/ thob la ma nyams pa de nyid/ so thar ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar khas blangs kyi/ sngags thob dus gtong rgyur ma bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ byang sems snying po byang chub kyi bar du khas blangs kyi/ sngags thob dus nyams rkyen dang gtong rgyur ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ngo bo sngags su rdzas gcig pas gzhan gnyis gnas 'gyur yin la/ ldog cha so sor ma 'dres te khas blangs pa'i cha las nyams rkyen ma byung bar so sor gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /de la so thar gyi gtong rgyu bslab pa phul ba la sogs pa mtshan nyid pa gnyis dang gzhan bdun bshad la/

byang sems kyi mchod 'os bslu ba la sogs pa nag po'i chos bzhi bshad de/ shing rta chen por bshad pa bzhin no/ /yon tan yar ldan ni/ sngags su gzhan gnyis 'du ba ste/ bre gsum du do 'du ba bzhin no/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po las/ bla med mchog gi sdom pa ru/ / 'dul ba'i dbang gis tshul khrims dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa kun/ /ma lus kun 'dus rnam par dag /ces pa dang*/ pad+ma cod pan las/ dbang gsum bgrod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de ni dge slong chen por gsungs/ /de yis thams cad bya ba nyid/ /ces so/ /dus skabs kyi gtso bor gang 'gyur ba ni/ gsang spyod kyi dus su sdom pa gsum gyi ltung ba nang ma 'dzom pa rnams ni ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su bsrung*/ 'og ma khyad du mi bsad/ 'doms na sngags gtso cher bsrung zhing dgag dgos yar ldan du 'gyur bar bya'o/ /tshogs gseb tu'ang ma 'dzom na ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su bsrung*/ 'doms na 'og ma gnyis gtso cher bsrungs pas sngags kyi dgongs pa shin tu gsang ba dang mthun zhing*/ gzhan ma dad pa spangs pas dgos pa yar ldan du 'gyur ro/ /'di dag ni sdom pa gsum gyi rnam par gzhag pa ste/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa sdom pa sum ldan rnams la shin tu gces pa'i mdzod du shes par bya'o/ / de ltar sdom pa gsum gyis legs par bsdams pa'i gang zag

/las dang po yis gtso bor rang don bsgrub/ dben par sems bsrung rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi btang*/ /rkyen ngan spang zhing gnyen pos nyon mongs 'dul/ /lta spyod ma 'dzol sgom pa lhur blangs shing*/ /dug lnga rang rgyud gang skyes skad cig la/ /dran pas gzung zhing ma yengs gnyen po bsten/ /sgo gsum bag yod shes shing ngo tsha shes/ /khrel yod ldan pas rang rgyud gdul bar bya/ /thar lam dang por zhugs pa dag gis dngos don gtso bor bsgrubs la/ rgyud dang yid kyis gzhan la phan pa bsam pa las/ mthu med pa dang*/ rang gi rgyud nyon mongs pa'i phyir rkyen ngan pa dang*/ dben sa bsten pa dang*/ nyon mongs la gnyen po bsten pa dang*/ lta spyod ma 'dzol bas nyams su blang ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa de gang skyes pa de dran pas bzung nas/ skad cig gnyis par rgyud la mi bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /lus ngag yid gsum dran shes bzhin bag yod gsum gyis shes par bya ba mchog tu gces te/ spyod 'jug las/ sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams la ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /srog la bab kyang srungs shig ces/ /bdag ni de skad thal mo sbyor/ /ces so/ khyad par blo rkyen khar 'chor bas rkyen snang dang rang snang gi chos la gdams pa ni/ bstod smad dgag sgrub snyan dang mi snyan la/ /sgyu ma rmi lam bden med mgo snyoms bya/ /brag ca'i sgra ltar rjes mthun bzod pa bsgom/ /nga bdag 'dzin pa'i sems kyi rtsa ba bcad/ /mdor na ci byed chos dang mi 'gal bas/ / rang gi rgyud bsdams gzhan la mi gnod cing*/ /nyon mongs phyogs su skad cig ma song bar/ /nyin mtshan dge bas 'da' ba shin tu gces/ /bstod smad dang bde dogs ci byung dus phyi nang thams cad rmi lam sgyu mar shes pas/ yul med brag ca ltar bsam pa dang*/ nang sems kyi khong khro dang zug rngu de nyid ngo bo ngos gzung dbyibs dang kha dog gang du'ang ma grub par brtags te/

spyod 'jug las/ ye nas skye med ngang nyid las/ /mi dgar ci yod dgar ci yod/ /thob pa ci yod shor ci yod/ /thams cad nam mkha' 'dra bar ni/ / bdag 'dras yongs su shes par bgyi/ /zhes so/ / mdor na nyin mtshan thams cad du gang ci byed kyang rang rgyud 'ba' zhig 'dul bas/ gzhan la mi gnod nyon mongs pa rang zhi/ dge ba ngang gis 'phel te/ sangs rgyas bstan pa la bslab pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /klu sgrub kyis/ nyid kyis thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis/ /sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ so thar las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes so/ /da ni de dag gi 'thad pa 'god pa las/ dang po gzhan don bsgrub dka' ba'i phyir rang don ma shor ba la gdams pa ni/ deng sang dus ngan skye bo mi bsrun pas/ /dben par rang don bsgrub pa shin tu gces/ /'dab gshog ma rdzogs 'phur bar mi nus ltar/ /mngon shes mi ldan gzhan don mi nus pas/ /rang don lhur blangs yid kyis gzhan phan bsam/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi bdud kyi bslu brid 'dis/ /rang sems ma bslus sgrub la 'bad pa gces/ /'chi dus 'gyod pas gdung bar ma byed cig /deng sang ni sangs rgyas byon yang 'dul bar mi nus na/ bdag 'dra phan sems tsam yod kyang gdul bya dus la ni ma babs/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dang mi ldan/ stobs kyis 'god par mi nus pas/ gzhan don gyi gzugs brnyan mi nyan pa'i kha ta 'di zhog la/ dben pa'i nags 'dab bzang por sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa la bskul te/ tshe 'di rnam g.yeng bdud kyi bslu brid 'dis sngar bslus pas des chog gi /da snying nas dben par gcig pur 'gro dgos te/ 'chi ba'i dus su 'gyod pas mi gdung bar 'ong nges pas rang don bya ba la 'bad de/ gzhan don yid kyis bsam pa'i dus lags so/

/zhi ba lha'i zhal nas kyang*/ sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /rgyal bas kyang ni ma mgu na/ /bdag 'dra ngan pas smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /rang don bsgrub par brtsams kyang brten so zin par dka' ba'i phyir yang 'bad dgos par gdams pa ni/ /de bas da lta sems la ser gdab ste/ /da lta 'chi na 'khyer so ci 'dug ltos/ / gar 'gro cir 'gyur brten so ma zin par/ /rnam g.yeng 'khrul pas nyin mtshan 'da' ba 'di/ /dal 'byor don med chud zos byed pas na/ /gcig pur dben par snying po'i don bsgom zhing*/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma da res legs dgos so/ /shi nas gar 'gro bdag la cha yod dam/ /de bas de ring nyid du brtson par bya/ /kha nang du ltos shig rang nyid da lta 'chi na bde zhing skyid pa'i gnas 'dir 'gro zhes tshags su tshud pa yod dam med/ nyin mtshan rnam g.yeng gis 'da' ba 'di dal 'byor chud zos su byed pa 'di soms la gtan gyi 'dun ma da res legs pa zhig bya dgos pas dus 'di nyid/ 'dug sa 'di nyid nas snying nas chos la brtson dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni/ /mi lus kyang ni thob mi 'gyur/ /mi lus thob par ma gyur na/ /sdig pa 'ba' zhig dge ba med/ /ces pa bzhin no/ / 'khrul snang bzod dka' bas da res 'bad dgos par gdams pa ni/ 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'jigs pa'i lam 'phrang 'dra/ /'di las thar thabs dgos so sems la zung*/ da res 'khrul na gtan du 'khrul par 'khyam/ /de bas brtson pa skyed cig snying la zhog /'khor ba mtho dman gyi sdug bsngal bsam zhing skyi g.ya' ba lam 'phrang 'jigs pa can nam g.yang sa chen po dang 'dra bas/ da res ma thar na gtan du thar dus med pa'i phyir 'bad dgos te/ zhi ba lhas/ g.yang sa tha mal chung ngu la'ang*/ /bag yod gnas par byed dgos na/ /dpag tshad stong du lhung ba yi/ /yun ring g.yang sar smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa bzhin no/

/srid mtsho brgal dka' bas da res 'bad dgos par gdams pa ni/ nyon mongs bdag 'dzin brgal bar dka' ba'i mtsho/ /dal 'byor gru bos da res brgal bar bya/ /thar lam byang chub brgya lam res 'ga' zhig /bsod nams dbang gis snang ba'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /snying nas brtson pas phan bde bsgrub par bya/ /nyon mongs pa ni rgya mtsho'i bying dang 'dra ba la/ da res kyi dal 'byor gru dang 'dra bas sgrol dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ gru 'di phyis nas rnyed dka' bas/ /rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces so/ /de'ang dal 'byor thob dka' ba thob/ 'khor 'das la skyon yon shes/ chos bsgrub dgos snyam pa'i blo bring tsam cig skyes pa 'di sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje rang gi snying la zhugs pas mun rum gyi glog dang 'dra zhing*/ bsod nams kyi blo 'byung dka' ba sems la byung ba'i dus 'di nas mgo bzung la 'bad dgos te/ de nyid las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /skyes bu don grub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis nas yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur/ /ji ltar mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig rab snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis brgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'ga' 'byung*/ /de ltas dge ba nyam chung nyid la brtag /ces so/ /'gal rkyen 'byung nye bas chos la 'bad dgos par gdams pa ni/ tshe yang mi rtag skad cig 'gyur ba ste/ /rnam g.yeng bslu mkhas phyi bshol dge la byed/ /'khrul pa rgyun ring goms pa brtan pa na/ / nyon mongs tshogs ni skad cig ngang gis 'byung*/ /bsod nams dge la 'bad kyang 'byung dka' bas/ /las kyi rlung shugs bzlog la 'bad pa gces/ /dus skad cig tsam mi rtag pa skyes bu'i tshe/ rnam g.yeng chos la bslu ba 'jig rten gyi snang ba/ phyi bshol dge ba la byed pa byis pa'i skye bo/

'khrul snang yun ring la goms pa 'khor ba'i sems can/ nyon mongs char bzhin 'bab pa khams gsum gyi 'gro ba/ bsod nams brgya lam byed pa rgyal ba'i phrin las/ rba brgal bzlog par dka' ba nyon mongs kyi rgya mtsho ste/ dus res 'ga'i chos su ma song bar/ brtson pas chos la 'bad pa shin tu gces pa lags so/ /ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ kye ma 'du byed rnam mi rtag /skye zhing 'jig par 'gyur ba ste/ /skyes nas 'jig par 'gyur ba bas/ de bas myur du zhi ba bde/ /zhes pa ltar bsam 'tshal lo/ /'khor bar snying po med pas chos la 'bad dgos par gdams pa ni/ 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba cung zad med/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal bsams na bzod glags med/ /'di las thar thabs da lan btsal bar bya/ /snying nas snying po'i don la ma 'bad na/ /dal khom res 'ga'i chos kyis phan mi thogs/ / de bas mi rtag skyo shas cher bskyed de/ /skad cig ma yengs sgrub la brtson 'grus bskyed/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bsams na/ bzod pa'i glags med pas/ 'di las da res thar pa'i thabs btsal ba la dal khom med par chos la brtson dgos so/ /de'ang byas blo dang shes blo gros mi chog ste/ phal po che las/ ji ltar mnyen pa mkhas pa zhig /skye bo mang po sgrol byed kyang*/ /rang nyid de na 'chi ba ltar/ /ma bsgoms chos kyang de dang 'dra/ /ji ltar 'on pa rol mo mkhan/ skye bo mang po mgu byed kyang*/ / rang nyid kyis ni ma thos ltar/ /ma bsgoms chos kyang de dang 'dra/ /ji ltar skye bo skom pa dag /chu ni mthong dang thos pa yis/ /skom pa'i sdug bsngal mi sel ltar/ /ma sgoms chos kyang de dang 'dra/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /da ni de thams cad gyi mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar dang po nyid du rtogs byas nas/ / phyis nas 'phags pa'i go 'phang myur du 'thob/ /rang don 'grub cing gzhan don ngang gis 'byung*/ /'khor ba'i gnas las thar pa'i lam mchog rnyed/

/ de phyir ci byed chos dang bstun pa ni/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag yin/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ thar pa'i phan yon/ da res 'bad pas chos bsgrub dgos par gdams pa rnams legs par rtogs nas 'bad na/ rang gzhan gyi don 'grub/ thar pa'i lam sna zin/ gtan gyi 'dun ma legs pa'i phyir/ gang ci byed kyang chos dang mthun pa ni byang chub bsgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu mdo rgyud thams cad las gsungs pa bdag gis de ltar bya ba la gdams so/ /sdug bsngal me tshogs spungs pa'i 'khor ba 'dir/ /bdag blo skyo bas zhi ba'i nags tshal du/ /da res tshe 'dis bgrod par bya'o zhes/ / snying nas brtson pas 'du 'dzi spang bar shog /rang don dam pa bsgrub pa'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /gzhan don ltar snang mngon par skyo ba can/ /sna tshogs sdug bsngal mang ldan 'dis ci byed/ /de bas gcig pur nags su gnas par shog /da res 'bad kyang gzhan la ci zhig phan/ /phyi nang gang na'ang bsam zhing skyo ba 'phel/ /de bas gcig pur brag ri'i drung 'dug ste/ /srog dang bcas pa'i lus 'dir 'dor bar shog /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta rnam dag las/ ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i gang zag bstan pa ste rdo rje'i gnas gnyis pa'o// // da ni gang bsgrub par bya ba'i chos bstan pa las/ re zhig mdor bstan pa ni/ gsum pa nyams su blang bya'i chos la gsum/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug gi rim pa dang gsum las/ re re zhing rgyas par dbye ba'i/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bstan pa/ mi rtag skyo shas phyi yi sngon 'gro ste/ /tshe 'di'i zhen pa gting nas zlog par byed/ /snying rje sems bskyed bye brag sngon 'gro ste/ /theg chen lam du chos rnams 'gro bar byed/ /de phyir thog mar sngon 'gro rnam gnyis sbyong*/ / theg pa chen po'i lam ji ltar bsgom yang de'i sngon du/

tshe mi rtag pa bsam pa dang*/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal du bsam pa dang*/ de la snying rje bsgom pa dang*/ de'i ched du rang nyid sangs rgyas thob par sems pa'i byang chub sems bsgom pa gces so/ /tshe mi rtag par shes pas sgrub pa long yod la mi 'chor ba dang*/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal du shes pas tshe 'di las blo ldog pa dang*/ snying rje phyogs med du bsgoms pas theg pa dman par mi ltung ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pas myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /de la thabs snying rje chen po dang*/ shes rab mtha' gnyis las mi gnas pa ni theg pa chen po'i khyad par gyi chos te/ sdud pa las/ thabs med shes rab bral bas nyan thos nyid du ltung*/ /zhes pa dang*/ rin chen phreng ba las/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /byang chub sgrub pa kha cig la'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*/ /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang*/ /thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang*/ /thabs kyi ring ba ma yin nyid/ /ces pa dang*/ do ha las/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang*/ / des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ /'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgoms na yang*/ /srid pa 'dir gnas thar pa thob mi 'gyur/ /gang dag gnyis po sbyor bar nus pa de/ /srid par mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ /zhes so/ /de nas mchog gi sngon 'gro bstan pa ni/ de rjes khyad par mchog gi sngon 'gro ni/ /dbang rdzogs thob nas bskyed pa'i rim gnyis te/ /rang lus lha dang snod bcud lhar gsal bas/ /tha mal 'dzin pa'i zhen pa zlog par byed/ / lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa yis/ /byin rlabs tshad med thugs rje shugs las 'char/ /bar chad kun sel dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /de phyir de rjes sngon 'gro rnam gnyis bsgom/ /dbang legs par thob nas bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa la dang por zhugs pa ni tshogs lam chung ngur tshud nas thar pa'i lam sna zin par 'dod pas/

lam gyi gzhi dbang yin la/ de thob nas sngags thun mong du lam dngos bskyed rdzogs spel ma stan thog gcig tu bsgom par grags kyang*/ 'dir rdzogs pa chen po'i rnam gzhag gis/ lha bskyed pa dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rtsa thig rlung gsum phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa thams cad rdzogs pa chung ngu dmigs bcas su bsdus nas lam gyi sngon 'gror bstan pas de dag gi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad na/ smin byed dbang dang grol byed bskyed rdzogs gnyis te/ snang ba rdo rje 'char ba'i rgyud las/ gang phyir rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /gsungs pa'i don ni rna mang po/ /mdor bsdus rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /smin pa dang ni grol ba 'o/ /zhes so/ /dbang la grangs nges pa/ go rims nges pa/ sgra don bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ dag bya nyon mongs pa bzhi dang*/ sgrub byed phyag rgya bzhi dang/ nyams dga' ba bzhi dang*/ 'bras bu sku bzhi la sogs brtson par byed pa la dbang bzhir grags so/ /go rims nges pa la lta ba dang sbyar ba dang*/ rten dang brten pa dag tshul dang sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po ni bum dbang gis snang sems sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gnas pas sems tsam gyi lta ba rtogs/ gsang dbang gis chos thams cad spros bral rab tu mi gnas par bstan pas dbu ma'i lta ba rtogs/ shes rab ye shes dbang gis bde stong dbyer med du bstan pas gsang sngags nang pa gnyis kyi lta ba rtogs/ tshig dbang gis blo 'das rig pa byang chub kyi sems su bstan pas rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba rtogs so/ /gnyis pa rten dang brten pa dag tshul dang sbyar na/ lus sems tshogs pa gcig gis rten dang brten pa byin gyis rlob cing 'dag par byed de/ lus kyi ngo bo rtsa/ de la rlung dang thig le/ de la rig pa byang chub kyi sems brten pas/ lus dag cing smin par byed pa la bum dbang*/ rtsa dag cing smin par byed pa la gsang dbang*/

thig le dag cing smin par byed pa la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ rig pa byang chub kyi sems dag cing smin par byed pa la tshig dbang rin po che'o/ /sgra don ni a bhi ṣiñtsa dang ṣe ka ta ste dri ma 'khrud cing skal pa 'jog pa'i phyir dbang ngo*/ / de yang tshe 'dir sa rab tu dga' ba'i bden mthong la sbyor bar dbang bas kyang dbang du bshad de/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ dkyil 'khor cho ga ji lta bu/ /cho ga chos dang rnal 'byor te/ /gsang ba thar pas yang dag 'byung*/ /skye ba 'di nyid kho na la/ /rab dga' sgrub par byed pa yin/ /zhes so/ /dbang ma thob pa'i nyes pa ni/ gsang snying las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing*/ / dbang rnams thob par ma byas par/ /nyan pa la sogs rtsom pa rnams/ / 'bras bu med cing rlag par 'gyur/ /ces pa dang*/ sgyu ma bde mchog las/ dkyil 'khor 'di ni ma mthong bar/ /rnal 'byor pa ni dngos grub 'dod/ / mkha' la khu tshur gyis brdeg dang*/ /rmongs pa phub ma brdungs dang mtshungs/ /zhes so/ /dbang thob pa'i phan yon ni/ gsang ba mchog las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /ma 'bad par yang dngos grub thob/ / ces so/ /dbang gi rnam gzhag go /grol byed lam gyi rim pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis te/ gsang 'dus las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag bstan/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa dang po ste/ / rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis pa'o/ /zhes so/ /bskyed rim ni/ kun rdzob lha'i snang ba la brten nas tha mal gyi rtog pa spang zhing phung po khams dang skye mched kyi tshogs bdun pa'i chos dag par sbyangs la/ rdzogs rim ni phra mo'am bsam gyis mi khyab don dam pa'i dbyings dang mthun pa la brten nas nang sems kyi spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i rang bzhin du shar ba ste/ zung du 'brel pa ni dngos grub kyi lam du bshad pa ni/ gur las/ phyag rgya chen por rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje'i sku ni bsgrub par bya/

/rin chen bzlas pa'i bzlas pa las/ / dri med rdo rje'i gsung du 'gyur/ /bsam gtan rdo rje rab bsams na/ /rin chen sems su rab tu 'grub/ /ces pa dang*/ de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes/ /thabs ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor nga rgyal gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid yun ring mi 'gyur/ /ces so/ /de la bskyed pa med par rdzogs par mi rung ste/ mkha' 'gro sdom pa las/ lha dang bral ba'i lam de ni/ /log pa'i lam du byung ba ste/ /sngags kyi lam du de mi rung*/ /zhes so/ /de la gdod ma nas sku gsung thugs rdo rjer gnas kyang bag chags kyi sgrib pas mi gsal ba nyid/ gsal bar byed pa la rim gnyis kyi 'khor lo bsgom pa yin te/ kye rdor las/ lha yi rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bskyed pa tsam gyis rnal 'byor gnas/ /gzhan la kha dog gnas pa ni/ /'on kyang bag chags phal pas sangs/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i yon tan ni/ gur las/ sangs rgyas de nyid gang bsgoms pa/ /byang chub ma thob na yang skye/ / skye zhing skye ba rnams su de/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i go 'phang 'gyur/ /yang na sa bdag nyid du 'am/ /dag pa'i gnas su nges par 'gro/ /zhes so/ /de ltar go don spyir bzhag nas/ thun mgor ji ltar bsgom pa'i rim pa ni rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhi khro gang rung ngam/ rigs thams cad kyi bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du bsgoms la yi ge brgya pa bzlas te/ rgyal ba gcig bsgoms sangs rgyas kun gyi ngang*/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /ji ltar zhe na/ sangs rgyas thams cad rigs lnga'i dbye bsdu las ma 'das shing*/ de yang zhi khro gnyis las ma 'das par ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir te/ sam+bu ṭi las/ lha rnams thams cad zhi ba'am/ /yang na khro bor bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan bsam mi khyab/ /bdag gis brjod par ga la nus/ /thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /stong pa'i rdo rje can zhig

ni/ /rigs ni rnam pa nga ru 'gyur/ /ces so/ /de'ang phreng ba de gang bsgom pa'i yi dam du bskyed la ye shes pa bstim/ mchod bstod bya/ rten 'brel snying pos me tog gtor/ yab yum 'od du zhu nas mdo 'dzin la thim pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ phreng rdog gzhan rnams ā li kā lir gsal btab la/ sngags bzlas dus yi ge de dag lha dang sngags kyi rang sgra 'phro bar byed par bsams la/ mis mi mthong bar 'phreng ba khung du bcang ngo*/ /sngags kyang la la ming nas 'bod par dang*/ /la la gnad nas bskul ba/ la la yon tan brjod pa yin te/ gur las/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang btsun mo dag

/mngon par phyogs par bya phyir te/ /dper na skyes chen 'ga' zhig la/ /che la myur ba'i sgras 'bod na/ /thos pa tsam gyis 'ong ba ltar/ /sangs rgyas skad cig de la 'byon/ /zhes so/ /sngags shin tu dag dgos te/ rgyud sde kun nas sngags bsdu ba gsungs pa'i don yin no/ / de'ang ma dag pa stong bzlas pa bas dag pa gcig 'gyur che la/ dmigs pas ma zin pa'am dmigs pa yengs pas 'bum bzlas pa bas/ ma yengs pa gcig 'gyur che ste/ gsang ba mchog las/ dag dang ma dag stong 'gyur la/ /ting 'dzin yod med 'bum du 'gyur/ /ces pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun/ /yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang*/ / sems gzhan g.yeng bas zin pa ni/ /de nyid rig pas don med gsungs/ / zhes so/ /de ltar yi dam lhar bskyed nas sngags cung zad bzlas nas/ spyi bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor bar bsams la/ mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ bshags pa dang*/ gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba 'debs par byas te/ lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ye shes mngon 'byung las/ sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams/ /bla ma'i mos gus lo bzlas bgrod/ /bla ma'i snang ba ma bral na/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'bral med gnas/ /zhes dang*/ dam tshig bkod pa las/ g.yo med mos gus zla drug gis/ /rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob 'gyur/ /ces pa dang*/ ye shes dam pa las/ spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan nyid du/ /dpal ldan bla ma bsam par bya/ /zhes so/ /des ni bar chod med cing rtogs pa rang shugs kyis 'char/ sa lam ngang gis bgrod pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /sngon 'gro sbyangs pa'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ de ltar sngon du 'gro lo bzhi dang lus nang kun gang ste/ /bde bas khyab dus snying gar baṃ yig las/ /haṃ gi bdud rtsi rgyun chad med par 'bab/

/bde ba'i nyams ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom/ /de nas baṃ yang je chung je phra la/ /dmigs gsum spros dang bral ba'i ngang du bzhag /thabs des sems zin bde bas zhi gnas skye/ /'dir slob dpon shrī sidhas slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la gdams pa/ bde gsal rnam par mi rtog pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i snyan brgyud ji lta ba bzhin bstan pa las/ dang po thabs kyi bde ba dam pa ni/ snang srid lha dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor du bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ sbyo bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhir gsal ba'i dbus ka ba'i tshul du g.yas ro ma dkar ba/ g.yon rkyang ma dmar ba/ dbus kun 'dar ma mthing ga /yar sna spyi gtsug mar sna gsang gnas su sleb pa las/ khyad par du dbu ma de je che la/ gro sog tsam/ u bhi tsam/ bzho dong tsam/ mthar lus thams cad dbu ma'i rang bzhin du srab sang sang song ba'i nang du sems gtad pas/ rtsa gnas gang du sems zin yang dbu ma'i yon tan 'ba' zhig 'char ba'i gnad do/ /de ltar dbu ma'i nang lte ba'i thad drang du a shad me'i rnam pa skra rtse tsam las me rta rnga tsam 'bar te/ spyi bo'i haṃ sran ma tsam la reg pas bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs te/ 'khor lo bzhi dang lus thams cad gang zhing*/ khyad par du snying ga na baṃ sngo skya la bab pas bde ba bskyed par bsams la/ sems ma yengs par bsgoms pas/ bde phril ba byung dus baṃ de je chung je phra las mthar yal nas ci yang med pa'i ngang la sems mnyam par gzhag go /thabs des bde stong spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes rang la yod pa de dus der 'char ba'i gnad do/ /bde stong gi 'od gsal shar ba de rang ngo sprad pa ni/ de nas gang yang bsam brjod 'das pa'i sems/ /blo bral nam mkha' 'dra ba'i ngang nyid 'char/

/de nas 'od gsal bde stong rdzogs pa che/ /rang bzhi bsam gyis mi khyab chos nyid yin/ /bde ba'i thabs la ci yang mi dmigs par bsgom pa na/ de dang rjes su mthun pa lus sems bde la sems spro bsdu dang bral ba'i rig pa rang dngas har sang nam mkha' 'dra ba zang thal shar ba ni bde ba 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po rang byung gi ye shes rang ngo 'phrod pa yin no/ / thig le gsang ba las/ bde chen rdo rje bsam mi khyab/ /'od gsal nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i nyams kyi rim pa bstan pa ni/ de nyid bsgoms las nyams kyang rnam pa bzhi/ /gang snang thams cad bde bar 'char ba dang*/ /nyin mtshan bde ba'i ngang nas 'bral mi phod/ /chags sdang la sogs zug rngus rgyud mi 'khrugs/ /chos kyi tshig don sbyor ba'i shes rab skye/ khams dngas ma rgyas pa'i nyams las snang ba 'char ba dang*/ nyin mtshan bde bas 'da' ba dang*/ zug rngus sems mi 'khrugs pa gsum 'char bas/ rig pa rang ngo mthong ba'i nyams las shes rab khyad par can dang*/ thugs rjes brtan pa 'char ba yin no/ /yon tan ni/ de nas yang bsgom spyan dang mngon shes sogs/ /yon tan dpag med nyi ma sems la 'char/ /'di ni yang zab gnad kyi gdams pa yin/ /bde stong bsam gyis mi khyab bsgoms pa las sngar bas lhag pa'i brtan pa thob pas spyan dang mngon par shes pa dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i yon tan 'char ro/ /de nas gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes brtan pa las/ thabs kyi rim pa ji ltar bsgom pa ni/ gnyis pa gsal ba'i thabs kyi ngo sprad pa/ / sngon 'gro sngar bzhin rtsa gsum gsal btab pa'i/ /ro rkyang gug nas dbu mar 'jug pa'i tshul/ /mar snar bsgoms la yar sna sna bug gtad/ /rlung ro gsum bus nad gdon sdig sgrib song*/ /dal bus gsum rngub brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten kun/ /'od zhu sna nas tshur byung ro rkyang nas/ /dbu ma'i nang byung snying dbus tshon gang 'od/

/gong bu la thim thub thang bar du bzung*/ /steng 'og kha sbyar gtong dus cung zad bzung*/ /dal bus 'byung rngub bya ba shin tu gces/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas la sogs yon tan kun/ /snying gar thim las gzhan du ma yengs bya/ /thabs des sems gsal dngas la gnas pa 'byung*/ /rtsa bsgom pa'i bar sngar dang 'dra ba'i ro rkyang gnyis kyi mar sna dbu mar tshud/ yar sna sna bug gnyis nas phar rlung ro bus pas nad gdon phyir song*/ dal bus rngubs pas 'jig rten gsum po sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'od kha dog lngar gyur pa sna bug nas lam byung*/ mar sna nas yar zhugs pas rlung snying gar thim pas/ dbu ma ye shes lnga'i rlung gis gang ba la sems bzung bas gsal stong mi rtog pa'i 'od gsal 'char ro/ / 'di ni mchog tu zab mo ste/ 'jig rten dbang du 'du ba dang*/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i byin rlabs myur du zhugs pas/ shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin sngon med pa 'char ba'o/ /de nas 'od gsal rnam sbyong gi dmigs pa ni/ de rjes snying ga'i 'od las 'od mched de/ /lus nang 'khor lo bzhi nas 'bar ba las/ /phyir mched 'od kyis 'jig rten khyab par bsgom/ /zhag 'gar nyin mtshan de nyid don bsgoms pas/ /rmi lam 'gag dang 'od kyi snang ba ni/ /zla ba 'bar ba me khyer skar ma sogs/ /'od lnga'i snang bas phyi nang khyab par mthong*/ /gsal ba'i ngang du sems zin zhi gnas skye/ /dbu ma'i nang du ye shes kyi 'od bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ 'khor lo bzhi dang lus nang thams cad khyab pa dang*/ de nas phyir mched de 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkhas gar khyab ye shes kyi 'od lngas khyab pa la sems bzung la rlung kha sbyor du gzung zhing*/ phyir gtong dus rlung zhabs cung zad bzung la/ dal bus rngub ste bsgoms pas/ dbu mar ye shes lnga'i rlung zin pa'i rtags su bsgom khang nye 'khor du 'od lnga'i snang ba dang*/ sgron me 'bar ba lta bu dang*/

zla ba shar ba lta bu dang*/ srin bu me khyer lta bu dang*/ du ba dang*/ sprin dang*/ skar ma lta bu dang*/ thig le lta bu dang*/ lha'i gzugs brnyan lta bu la sogs pa'i snang ba dpag tu med pa 'char ro/ /'di'i dus su sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i zhi gnas dang*/ rang gsal rjen pa'i lhag mthong gnyis ngo bo gcig tu 'char ro/ /snang ba rnam dag gi bsam gtan ni/ de nas slar bsdu snying ga'i 'od zer yang*/ /je chung je phra stong nyid ngang bzhag pas/ /gang du'ang mi dmigs stong gsal dngas pa'i sems/ /rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i 'od gsal 'char/ /'od kyi snang ba thams cad 'khor lo bzhi nas snying gar bsdu/ /de yang je phra las nam mkha' ltar ci yang ma grub pa'i ngang la bzhag pas/ rig pa zang ka rgya phyam gsal dngas par shar ba ni gsal stong rang byung gi ye shes so/ /don de ngo sprad pa ni/ de ni gsal stong gnyug ma'i ye shes te/ / rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs yin/ dngas gsal zang ka'i ngo bo de ni stong gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs te/ kun byed las/ yid la mi byed mtshan ma'i rjes mi 'breng*/ /'di ni rang byung 'od gsal dgongs pa ste/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i nyams ni/ /de nyid goms pas nyams kyang rnam pa bzhi/ /gang snang 'al 'ol zang thal gsal ba snyam/ /nyin mtshan gsal ba'i ngang la gnas pa dang*/ /rnam rtog mi g.yo sems gsal dngas pa dang*/ /shes rab klong rdol gzung 'dzin bral ba 'o/ / de la rlung gi nyams su snang ba 'al 'ol zang thal pa snyam pa dang*/ nyin mtshan gsal dngas phyed pa dang*/ rtog pa 'gags la shes pa dngas pa gsum 'char la/ rig pa rang ngo shes pa'i ngang bskyangs pa'i nyams las gzung 'dzin med cing blo myur la shes rab che ba 'char ro/ /yon tan ni/ de yang goms las yon tan 'char ba dang*/ sgrib pas chod kyang pha rol zang thal sogs/ /mthong ba'i spyan dang rdzu 'phrul 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni yang zab gdams pa'i nying khu yin/

/rlung gi rnal 'byor goms pas ting nge 'dzin skye zhing*/ de'i mthus mngon shes 'char ba dang*/ rtsig pa la sogs pas bar du chod kyang de'i pha rol zang thal du mthong ba la sogs pa'i spyan dang rdzu 'phrul te/ sdud pa las/ bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor/ /rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par 'grub/ /ces so/ /de nas rig stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bstan pa las/ thabs kyi rim pa bshad de/ spyir rtsa dbu ma'i nang je cher song ba la sems gtad pas mi rtog pa 'grub pa ni gzhan dang mtshungs la/ khyad par du 'phang gzung sbyang gsum gyis rig pa'i gnad la bsger bas rnam par mi rtog pa btsan thabs su ngo sprad par bya ba ni/ gsum pa mi rtog thabs kyis ngo sprad pa/ / sngon 'gro sngar bzhin dngos gzhi rnam pa gsum/ /'phang ba gzung bar sbyang ba'i rim pa las/ /'phang ba snying gar sems nyid 'od gsal la ba/ / a'am 'od kyi gong bu tshon gang zhig /ha zhes nyer gcig ngar dang bcas brjod pas/ /rgyangs kyis spyi gtsug nas 'thon mkha' la song*/ /je mtho je mthor mthar ni bltar med pa'i/ /ngang du lus sems khong glod mnyam par gzhag /skad cig de la rnam rtog rgyun chad de/ /smra bsam brjod du med pa'i ngang du gnas/ /nyams kyang bltar med bsam yul 'das pa 'byung*/ /de la dbu ma'i stong ra yan chad sngar bzhin bsgoms pa'i snying gnas 'od lnga'i gong bu ya mtshan pa spyi gtsug las 'thon nas je mtho je mtho la song ba las/ mthar bltar med par song la/ ha drag po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod nas lus sems glod pas/ skad cig de la smra bsam brjod du med pa'i 'od gsal 'char ro/ /nyams kyang bsam du med pa nam mkha' lta bur myong ba'o/ / thabs gnyis pa rig pa/ gzung pa nyi ma'i ngos la rgyab gtad de/ /dngas pa'i mkha' la mig gtad lhan ner bzhag /rlung rgyu mi tshor ci nas dal bar bya/ /mi rtog spros dang bral ba kho nas 'char/

/rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyams skye/ /nam mkha' rab tu dngas pa'i tshe nyi ma la rgyab bstan nas mig mi 'gul bar nam mkha'i dkyil la gtad cing rlung dal bas phyir gzung ba'i skad cig la stong pa'i 'od gsal 'char ro/ /nyams kyang dngas sangs/ rgya chad dang phyogs lhung med pa nam mkha' lta bu 'byung ste/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*/ /zhes pas rten 'brel gnad gcig pa'i phyir ro/ / skabs 'dir nam mkha' sum sprugs kyi dgongs pa 'char te/ stong gsal phyi'i nam mkha' la brten nas/ rtog med nang gi nam mkha' shar dus/ zang thal gsang ba'i nam mkha' rig stong rjen par rtogs te/ thabs dang byin rlabs kyis bsgoms las mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni bal po ka ma la shī la'i gdams pa mchog tu zab mo'o/ /thabs gsum pa rig pa rjen par/ sbyangs pa mkha' la mi gtad ma yengs par/ /sems gsal spro bsdu med pa'i ngang de nas/ /sa rdo ri brag snod bcud thams cad kyang*/ /zang thal nam mkha' gcig tu song bar bsgom/ /rang gi lus kyang rags pa'i mngon zhen med/ /sems dang nam mkha' dbyer med ngang du gzhag /phyi nang bar sum rnam g.yeng med pa'i chos/ /nam mkha'i ngang der lus sems khong glod la/ / dran bsam yid la byed pa rang zhi'i ngang*/ /spro bsdu med pa'i sems nyid rang sor gzhag /de tshe chos nyid bsam brjod 'das pa'i sems/ /gnyis med nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa 'char/ /'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba'i snying po yin/ /nam mkha' la rig pa gtad pas stong par phyam gyis song dus/ phyi snang ba'i dngos po sa rdo ri brag la sogs pa snod bcud thams cad zang thal rang yal song nas bar snang 'di dang 'dres par bsam dus/ rang gi lus kyang rang yal nam mkha' bzhin du song ste/ thams cad nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar phyi nang bar med har sang phyal ba'i ngang la sems spro bsdu med par bzhag pas/ mtha' grol nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa rang shar du byung ba ni/

ka dag chos zad kyi dgongs pa zhes bya ste/ kun byed las/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bya lam gnas/ /zhes pa dang*/ sdud pa las/ don 'di gang yin nam mkha' dag la brtag par gyis/ /zhes so/ /thabs des bsgoms pa'i nyams bstan pa ni/ de ltar bsgoms pas nyams kyang rnam pa bzhi/ /gang snang phyam phyam rags pa'i 'du shes med/ /nyin mtshan mi rtog ngang las 'bral mi phod/ /dug lnga rang zhi sems rgyud 'jam la des/ /chos kun nam mkha' 'dra ba'i nyams myong skye/ /'phang ba gang gzung ba dang sbyang ba gsum bsgoms pa las/ dbu ma'i rtsa sbug dang rig pa ngo bo'i nyams las ci snang gi snang ba thams cad sang seng khral khrol phyam phyam gcig tu shes te rags pa'i 'du shes med pa dang*/ nyin mtshan rtog med la gnas pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa skye rgyu med pa ltar song nas/ rkyen gang la'ang bde dogs med pas ngang rgyud 'jam des su gnas pa dang*/ chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar skye ba med pa'i de kho na nyid rtogs nas bya rtsol gyi 'du shes med pa'o/ /yon tan ni/ de ltar mi rtog gsum la goms pa yis/ /spyan dang mngon shes ting 'dzin yon tan 'grub/ /thabs dang shes rab zhi lhag zung 'brel bas/ / gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis phun tshogs 'grub/ /thabs gsum pa goms pas ting nge 'dzin 'grub ste/ spyan dang mngon shes dang*/ ting nge 'dzin sngar med pa dang*/ thabs dang shes rab zung 'brel dang*/ zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi lam grub nas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi sa lam dang yon tan thams cad 'grub pa yin no/ /de dag gi dngos gzhi ji ltar bsgoms pa'i rim pa bstan zin to/ /don gsum pa dngos gzhi nyams su len pa la grogs phan pa'i yan lag mjug gi go cha yin pas/ de bstan pa ni/ gsum pa rjes kyi chos la rnam pa bzhi/ /nyams dang bogs 'byin rtogs pa 'bras bu'o/ /zhes mdor bstan nas/ rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi las/ dang po/ nyams la gnyis las skyon med sngar bstan la/

/skyon can so so'i 'dzin zhen las byung ba/ /bde chags gsal chags mi rtog chags pa dang*/ /mthar 'dzin zhen log dug dang 'dres pa gsum/ /bde log khams 'dzag 'dod chags rang ga dang*/ /snying mi dga' dang bying pa shas che dang*/ /gsal log rlung rgod zhe sdang rang ga dang*/ /rnam rtog rags dang rgod cing 'phro shas che/ / mi rtog log pa gti mug rang ga dang*/ /sems bying gnyid rmugs che dang 'du shes med/ /de ltar mthun dang log pa'i skyon can rnams/ /gang byung ngos gzung gnyen pos bcos par bya/ /de la goms pa na nyams 'char te/ de yang bzang nyams dang ngan nyams gnyis su 'du ba las/ bzang nyams ni sngar bstan zin to/ /ngan nyams la tshad med kyang*/ bsdu na bde ba gsal ba mi rtog pa gsum gyi 'dzin zhen log pa las gyur pa gsum las/ dang po ni bde bar bsgom dus bde ba'i ngang la chags pa dang*/ sems nyid bde stong du 'dug snyam pa'i 'dzin zhen dang*/ de las gzhan pa yang dag gi lam ma yin no snyam pa dang*/ de nyid la mthar 'dzin pa dang*/ bde ba 'dod chags kyi dug dang 'dres pa ma tshor ba ste/ gnyen po las gyur pa lnga dang*/ bde log thig le'i gegs te 'dzag pa dang*/ /'dod chags rang gar 'char zhing dbang po rengs pa dang*/ khams 'dzag pas snying mi dga' ba dang*/ nyog pas shes pa bying rmugs su gyur pa dang*/ /yul yid la byed pa'i 'dod chags te/ spang bya las gyur pa lnga'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rlung bsgom dus/ gsal ba'i ngang la chags pa dang*/ sems nyid gsal stong du 'dzin pa dang*/ gzhan gyi lam la btang ba dang*/ de la mthar zhen pa dang*/ gsal ba zhe sdang gi dug dang 'dres pa mtshor ba ste/ gnyen po las gyur pa lnga dang*/ gsal log rlung gi gegs te rlung ha cang rgod pa dang*/ zhe sdang rang ga mar 'chor pa dang*/ rnam rtog lhag gis rags pa dang*/ rlung 'thom pa za zir 'khor ba dang*/ gcig tu sdod snying mi 'dod pa ste/ spang bya las gyur pa lnga'o/

/gsum pa ni mi rtog pa bsgom dus/ rtog med kyi ngang la chags pa dang*/ sems nyid stong chad du 'dzin pa dang*/ lam gzhan la btang ba dang*/ stong pa la mthar 'dzin pa dang*/ gti mug gi dug dang 'dres pa ma tshor ba dang*/ gnyen po las gyur pa lnga dang*/ stong log rtog med kyi gegs te shes pa lung ma bstan gti mug rang ga dang*/ dngas ma phyin pas bying ba dang*/ gsal cha ma thon par rmugs pa dang*/ rang gsal rjen pa la ma bud pas stong pa dang*/ dran med stong pa la phyang chad kyi ngang la 'du shes kyi rgyu ba med par 'gag pa ste/ spang cha las gyur pa lnga'o/ /de thams cad bsdoms pas sum cur gnas pa ni nyams su skyon can te/ bcos thabs thun mong ba ni so so ngos bzung la/ de'i gnyen por gang che bsten te go bar sla'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa ni rig pa rang ngo shes pa'i gnad gcig bu 'dis bcos te/ gegs gang byung yang ngos bzung la/ bla ma'i mos gus gsol ba 'debs dang bcas pa drag la byin phebs pa cig byas nas/ gegs de gang las byung*/ ga na 'dug

/su gnod brtags pas de rnams ma rnyed pa rig pa zang ka /rjen pa de sang nge 'dug dus/ thams cad rig pa'i rang mdangs su grol te/ bar chad dngos grub tu shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhes bya'o/ /de yang gang shar ci byung skyon yon du gyur tshad/ thams cad rig pa'i rol pa las gzhan med de/ bde yang rig pa sdug kyang rig pa na yang rig pa dga' yang rig pa/ kho ma gtogs pa gang yang med pas/ gnad 'di go na shin tu skyid pa cig lags so/ /kho bos gegs thams cad 'dir bsal bas shin tu skyid par byung ngo/ /gegs dang mi 'dod pa ci byung dus dge sbyor du hril 'gro ba cig rnal 'byor pa la dgos pa lags so/ /de ma yin par thabs gzhan byed na sdug pa zhes bya ste/ gag po gdod kyis mchi'o/ /gang byung yang nang du rnam rtog la rig pa dngas phyed par mdzod dang gegs btsal gyis rnyed par mi gda'o/ /'di ni rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad gal po che mngon du phyung nas nyams len ltar bkod pa'o/ /don gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bogs gong du dbyung ba'i thabs ma nyams pa bcos pa dang*/ gong du spel pa gnyis las/ nyams skyon can bcos pa'i rim pa bstan pa ni/ bogs 'byin nyams bcos thabs dang gong du spel/ /nyams bcos pa yang rnam pa gsum nyid de/ /rab kyis lta bas bcos te chos rnams kun/ /blo btags sgyu 'dra ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /phyam gcig mkha' 'dra snyems bral rang ngos stong*/ /'dzin zhen med pa'i ngang der la bzla 'o/ /gol sgrib nyams te gnas lugs chen por 'char/ /bar chad dge bskul rkyen ngan byang chub grogs/ /gzhi bde'i steng du blo bde rgyun mi 'chad/ /phyogs bral nam mkha' 'dra ba'i rtogs pa 'char/ /rnal 'byor pa rab kyis thams cad sgyu ma ltar ngo bo med par rtogs pas gegs gzhi grol chos nyid kyi rtogs pa 'char ba'o/ /de yang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du snang ba la rang bzhin med par ye nas gnas te/

brgyad stong pa'i brgya byin gyi le'u las/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu dag kho bo gal te mya ngan las 'das pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos gzhan zhig yod kyang de yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes smra'o/ /de ni 'di ltar sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ rmi lam lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos 'di dag ni gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med do zhes so/ /de'ang sems can la las kyi sgyu ma/ rnal 'byor pa la nyams kyi sgyu ma/ sangs rgyas la dag pa'i sgyu mar gnas pas chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu ste/ gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /rang byung dag par 'char ba ni/ /rnal 'byor pa la dngos grub kyi/ /'bras bu nyams snang sna tshogs pa'o/ khams gsum sems can thams cad la/ /las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal 'byung*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /phrin las dag pa'i stobs su 'char/ /zhes so/ /de yang rnal 'byor pas gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi sgyu mar shes par bya ste/ ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ gdod nas gzhi rnams ma grub pa/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i sgyu ma ste/ /go dang rtag chad nyams dang ni/ / gang shar rtogs pa'i sgyu ma 'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bskyed rdzogs sgyu ma'i rol par chos thams cad shes par bya ste/ de nyid las/ lha sku snang stong sgyu ma yi/ /ngo bo brjod bral blo las 'das/ /rang bzhin dbyer med mtha' dang bral/ /mtshan nyid ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs/ /de ltar chos rnams thams cad kun/ /mkhas pas yongs su shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na rkyen gyi sgyu ma med par gsal snang gi chos thams cad mtshon nas bden med bstan zhing*/ /las kyi sgyu ma khams gsum las thar bar bya ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi sgyu ma lam bsgom pa dang gang zag ngo bo med par bstan pa'i mthar ye shes sgyu ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub pas de ltar rtogs par gdams te/

sgyu ma mkhan bzang pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ las kyis sprul pa'i sgyu ma ni/ /'gro drug sems can thams cad do/ /rkyen gyis sprul pa'i sgyu ma ni/ /me long gzugs brnyan la sogs so/ /chos kyis sprul pa'i sgyu ma ni/ /nga yi 'khor gyi dge slong ngo*/ /nga ni yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ye shes sprul pa'i sgyu ma'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar blang dor shes pas sgyu mar sbyong ba'i dus nas/ chos thams cad yod med kyi mtha' las 'das par shes par bya ste/ gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ sgyu ma 'di ni yod med las 'das shing*/ dbu ma tsam du'ang mi gnas kun rdzob ste/ /chos rnams mi gnas sgyu ma'i rang bzhin las/ / 'gag pa med pa'i rol par rang byung ba'o/ /zhes so/ /'di dag gi tshul rgyas par sgyu ma ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta bzang por blta'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa 'bring gis sgom pas bcos te dngas phyung la/ /shes pa 'jur la thebs shing dran pas gzung*/ /ma yengs bde gsal mi rtog ngang la gzhag / yengs dang 'jur la ma thebs skyon yin pas/ /skad cig ma yengs ngang la gzhag pa gces/ /sgom skyon thams cad rig pa 'jur la ma thebs shing yengs pa las/ rten rtsa rlung thig le dang brten pa sems kyi gegs rnams 'byung bas/ /'dir rnal 'byor pa 'bring gis spyi dang bye brag gi bcos thabs gnyis su shes par bya ba las/ sbyir bcos pa ni gegs gang la'ang rig pa rang dngas bsgom pa ngos bzung nas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la dngas phyin par bsgoms pas/ sgom skyon de nyid sgom gyi ngo bo lhag med 'char ba yin no/ /brtag gnyis las/ ji ltar me yis tshig pa la/ /me de nyid kyis gso bar bya/ /ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs na/ /chu gzhan gyis ni 'byin pa ltar/ /zhes bshad pa dang chos mthun pa yin no/ /bye brag tu bcos pa la gsum las/ bde log bcos pa la ni/ khams 'dzag pa la rdo rje'i bum pa ru/

/hūm̐ las me 'bar lus nang khams kun bsregs/ /ci yang med pa'i ngang la bsgom pas sel/ /nad 'dzag gdon 'dzag gang la'ang gnad 'di thab/ /bde la 'dzin pa bshig nas stong par bsgom/ /'dod chags rang ka'i sems la cher bltas pas/ /bcos bslad re dogs med pa'i ngang bzhag pas/ /'dod chags rang grol bde stong ye shes 'char/ / snying mi dga' ba thig le nyams pa'i skyon/ /de la 'bar 'dzag bde ba'i bsam gtan bsgom/ /bying shas chen na dngas snyigs ma phyed skyon/ /de la lus gnad drang por 'dus byas la/ kha sbyar rlung bzung snying nang 'od kyis khengs/ /snang srid 'od khengs gsal stong bsgoms pas grol/ /bde stong bsgom dus gnyen po'i skyon lnga ni dga' brod du bzung ba las byung bas/ dga' dus kyi rang ngo la bltas pas stong par sang gis 'gro ba'i ngang la bsgoms pas sel lo/ /spang bya'i lnga las/ 'dod chags rang gar 'char na de'i ngo bo la gtad nas bsgoms pas 'dod chags rang grol bde ba chen por 'char ro/ /khams 'dzag na rdo rje'i bum par hūm̐ mthing nag las me 'bar te sa bon thams cad tshig nas stong par bsams pas sel lo/ /bying rmugs che na sngar rlung bsgoms pa'i tshul des sel lo/ /snying mi dga' na thig le'i yar 'jog ni/ lte ba'i a thung las me 'bar te/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas bdud rtsi babs pas lus khengs/ yang ba spu'i bu ga'i bar me 'bar bas khams dngas ma thams cad bzhu ste/ lus nang thams cad bde bas khyab par bsgoms te/ ngang nyid du/ /blo yi rnam pa spros dang bral bar gzhag / gegs dang spang bya'i 'phrang las grol bar nges/ /gegs dang bzang ngan gang la'ang ngos zin na rig pa las med pas/ rig pa 'dzin med stong gsal du bzhag pa tsam gyis sel te/ do ha las/ gang la zhen pa yod na de yang thongs/ /rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / don gsum pa/ dbang po/ tha mas spyod pas bcos pa'i rim pa yang*/

/ lta stangs rdzas dang rten 'brel gsum nyid las/ /spyi yi lta stangs rnam snang chos bdun te/ /skyil krung mig mi 'gul dang rlung dal dang*/ /mnyam gzhag mgrin pa dgug dang lce rtse rkan/ /sna rtser mig phab blta bas rlung sems snyoms/ /bying rgod med cing ma nor bsam gtan skye/ /'di ltar skyon kun lus gnad 'khrugs pa yis/ /rtsa 'khrugs rlung 'khrugs thig le 'khrugs las byung*/ /de bas ma 'khrugs mnyam par gzhag pa gces/ /yon tan yang ni rtsa thig rlung gsum nyid/ /mi g.yo gnad du song las 'byung bas na/ /de phyir gnad 'di rtog pa rab tu gces/ /de la gegs dang skyed med pa thams cad rtsa rlung gnad du gtong ba'i lus gnad ma shes na las 'byung zhing*/ yon tan yang lus gnad legs par bcas pa las 'byung ste/ rdo rje'i lus las rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi 'phro 'du legs nyes kyi byed pas bde sdug gi snang ba dang nyams bzang ngan du 'char ba'i phyir ro/ /sngon rang sangs rgyas mthong ba'i pha rol drang srong nags na 'khod pa'i drung du phyin pa na/ de dag la la ni nyal/ la la ni khros pa la sogs pa mthong nas spre 'us lus gnad bcos pas/ de dag gi rnam snang chos bdun de la ngo mtshar skyes pas/ lus gnad de bcas pas/ ring por ma thogs par bsam gtan bzhi dang mngon par shes pa lnga thob par 'dul ba lung las bshad do/ /de'i phyir lus drang por bsrangs te skyil krung bca' ba/ mig mi 'gul ba/ lag pa mnyam gzhag / lce rtse yar rkan/ mgrin pa an dgug /rlung dal bu/ mig thur la dbab pa ste bdun po bcas pa tsam gyis bsam gtan ngang gis skye ste/ rtsa rlung thig le rang bzhin gyis 'ching zhing rig pa rang gnas su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'di dag gi skabs su/ 'khrul 'khor lus sbyong gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ /khyad par dal 'jam ma 'khrugs gnad du che/ /'jam la rtsub dang rtsub la 'jam pa gnad/ /khams dang bstun pa shin tu gces pa yin/

/lus sbyong yang rtsa rlung gnad du 'gro ba'i grogs te/ 'chi med 'khrul 'khor sum cu rtsa gnyis gnad brtag gnyis las/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /zhes pa dang*/ saṃ pu ṭi las/ skra yi rtse mo'i khyon tsam ste/ /'od zer glog stong 'khyug pa bzhin/ /ba spu'i bu ga'i mtshams nas ni/ /byung nas phyogs bcur gnas pa yi/ /lha dang lha min sdigs par mdzod/ /ces so/ /gsal log bcos pa ni/ gsal 'dzin nyams la 'dzin med chen por sbyong*/ /gsal log rmugs na dngas gsal sems bsgom zhing*/ /rgod cing 'phro na mig btsums snying nang du/ /'od dang yi ge pad+ma ral gri dang*/ /rgya gram bsgoms la je dma' je dma' las/ /snying ga'i nang las lung thag je ring song*/ /'og gzhi gser gyi sa gzhir babs par bsgom/ /des ni mi sel mi srid nges pa'i gnad/ / zhe sdang rang ka 'phro rgod tsan ne bzhag /gsal stong me long ye shes ngang du grol/ /gsal chags gnyen po mchog zin lnga ni/ rang ngo de ngos bzung la bltas pas yul med rang grol la 'gro ba yin no/ /spang bya lnga las zhe sdang rang ka de'i ngo bo la bltas pas grol lo/ /rmugs 'thoms la dngas phyungs nas bsgoms pas sel lo/ /rlung rgod na mig btsums snying nang du lha'i yi ge bsgoms pas sel lo/ /sems rab tu 'phro zhing ma zin na snying nang nas pad+ma'am rdo rje rgya gram la sogs pa'i thur du yu ba'am thag pa je ring la song nas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la babs te bstan par bsams pa'i ngang la ring du bsgoms pas sel lo/ /nges pa'i gnad do/ /mi rtog pa'i las bcos pa ni/ mi rtog ngang 'char 'dzin med gnad kyis sbyang*/ /gti mug sems de ngos gzung cer gyis brtag /skad cig rang grol chos dbyings ye shes 'char/ /bying zhing rmugs te 'du shes med pa na/ /snying gar 'od bsgoms tshang bug nas 'thon te/ /gzhu gang tsam gyi nam mkhar ldeng nge gnas/

/de la sems bzung spros kun bral bar gnas/ /'di ni yang zab gnad kyi gdams pa yin/ /mi rtog pa bsgoms dus gnyen po la zhen pa lnga ni rang ngo la bltas pas sel la/ sbang bya lnga las gti mug gi sems rang ka ma de rang ngo la bltas pas rtog med rang dngas thon dus chos dbyings ye shes su grol lo/ /bying rmugs dang 'du shes med pa la sngon rol der dngas byung bas kyang sel la/ snying nas 'od sgo nga ltar 'tsher ba 'phar te/ steng gi gzhu gang gi nam mkha' la lding nge yod par sems bzung bas sel lo/ / 'di ni rig pa gsal ka ston pa zhes bya bar slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rje'i man ngag go /bsdu ba ni/ spyir ni gang la'ang 'dzin med gnad du che/ / re dogs bral na gegs rnams kun las grol/ /stong gsal sems nyid dngas pa'i ngang nyid du/ /blo yi rnam pa spros dang bral bar gzhag /gegs dang spang bya'i 'phrang las grol bar nges/ /gegs dang bzang ngan gang la'ang ngos zin na rig pa las med pas/ rig pa 'dzin med stong gsal du bzhag pa tsam gyis sel te/ do ha las/ gang la zhen pa yod na de yang thongs/ / rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /don gsum pa/ dbang po tha mar spyod pas bcos pa'i rim pa yang*/ /lta stangs rdzas dang rten 'brel gsum nyid las/ /spyi yi lta stangs rnam snang chos bdun te/ /skyil krung mig mi 'gul dang rlung dal dang*/ /mnyam gzhag mgrin pa dgug dang lce rtse rkan/ /sna rtser mig phab blta bas rlung sems snyoms/ / bying rgod med cing ma nor bsam gtan skye/ /'di ltar skyon kun lus gnad 'khrugs pa yis/ /rtsa 'khrugs rlung 'khrugs thig le 'khrugs las byung*/ de bas ma 'khrugs mnyam par gzhag pa gces/ /yon tan yang ni rtsa thig rlung gsum nyid/ /mi g.yo gnad du song las 'byung bas na/ /de phyir gnad 'di rtogs pa rab tu gces/ /de la gegs dang skyed med pa thams cad rtsa rlung gnad du gtong ba'i lus gnad ma shes na las 'byung zhing*/

yon tan yang lus gnad legs par bcas pa las 'byung ste/ rdo rje'i lus las rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi 'phro 'du legs nyes kyis byed pas bde sdug gi snang ba dang nyams bzang ngan du 'char ba'i phyir ro/ /sngon rang sangs rgyas mthong ba'i pha rol drang srong nags na 'khod pa'i drung du phyin pa na/ de dag la la ni nyal/ la la ni khros pa la sogs pa mthong nas spre 'us lus gnad bcos pas/ de dag gi rnam snang chos bdun de la ngo mtshar skyes pas/ lus gnad de bcas pas/ ring por ma thogs par bsam gtan bzhi dang mngon par shes pa lnga thob par 'dul ba lung las bshad do/ /de'i phyir lus drang po bsrangs te skyil krung bca' ba/ mig mi 'gul ba/ lag pa mnyam gzhag /lce rtse yar rkan/ mgrin pa an dgug /rlung dal bu/ mig thur la dbab pa ste bdun po bcas pa tsam gyis bsam gtan ngang gis skye ste/ rtsa rlung thig le rang bzhin gyis 'ching zhing rig pa rang gnas su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'di dag gi skabs su/ 'khrul 'khor lus sbyong gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par dal 'jam ma 'khrugs gnad du che/ /'jam la rtsub dang rtsub la 'jam pa gnad/ /khams dang bstun pa shin tu gces pa yin/ /lus sbyong yang rtsa rlung gnad du 'gro ba'i grogs te/ 'chi med 'khrul 'khor sum cu rtsa gnyis gnad/ la sogs pa/ rtsa rlung pa gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par du de dag gis lus ma 'khrugs par dal 'jam du bya ba gnad do/ /rlung yang 'jam rlung la bogs rtsub rlung gis 'don cing rtsub rlung la 'jam rlung gis 'don pa dang*/ gnyis ka'i rlung ma ning rlung gis rnal 'byor gyi bogs 'don pa ni gnad gal po che'o/ /bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum gyi lus gnad bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ bye brag bde la lag pa grub mor bsnol/ /mig phab bde la sems bzung gnad yin no/ /gsal la lag gnyis pus mo'i steng du dgab/ /rlung dal mig ni bar snang har por blta/

/mi rtog chos bdun rang kar gnas pas 'grub/ /bde ba bsgom dus chos bdun las lag ngar gnyis bsnol bas bde ba myong byed dang khams dang rlung 'ching ba'i gnad do/ /gsal ba bsgom dus mjing pa cung zad phyir bskyed/ lag pa pus mo la bkab rlung dal/ mig har por gtad pas 'od gsal gyi rang sor gnas pa'i gnad do/ /mi rtog pa ni chos bdun rang lugs kyis 'grub bo/ /nyams log pa'i gegs rdzas kyis bcos pa ni gsum nyid de/ rdzas ni dus dang mthun pa'i gnas dang grogs/ /bza' btung la sogs nyams la gang phan bsten/ /bde ba'i rdzas kha zas bcud can dang*/ sman sbrang rtsi'i ril bu bza' ba dang*/ grogs phyag rgya mtshan ldan bsten pa la sogs pa'o/ /gsal ba'i rdzas kha zas bsil ba dang gnas mtho zhing snang ba che ba la sogs pa'o/ /mi rtog pa'i rdzas gnas dro zhing 'thibs pa dang*/ zas drod dang*/ spyod lam dal bar gnas pa'o/ /nyams rten 'brel gyis bcos pa ni gsum nyid de/ rten 'brel khams 'dzag pa la gzhon nu mas/ /bkal ba'i skud pa sum sgril sngags bzlas te/ /sked par bcings pas thig le bsrung ba yin/ /rtog pa 'phro na tsan+dan ge sar dang*/ /zhun chen ril bu bsten pas mi rtog 'grub/ /rmugs na gur gum ga pur byang chub sems/ /ril bus ting 'dzin 'grub par rgyud las gsungs/ /bde nyams khams 'dzag na bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pas bkal pa'i skud pa sum sgril la/ khro bor bskyed nas drag sngags bzlas pa'i sngags mdud bdun byas pa'i srad bu sked par bcings pa'i sna gcig rdo rje'i rtsa bar bcings la nyal bas thub bo/ / rtog pa 'phro na gsal nyams 'grib ste/ tsan+dan dkar dmar dang*/ nā ga ge sar dang*/ mi'i zhun chen sbyar ba'i ril bu lto stong la bsten pas bsam gtan 'grub bo/ /bying rmugs ni mi rtog pa'i nyams 'phrog pa ste/ ga pur dang*/ gur gum dang*/ byang sems dkar dmar gyi ril bu bsten pas sel lo/

/sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ tsan+dan ge sar zhun chen gyis/ /rang bzhin sems dal bsam gtan 'grub/ /gur gum ga pur byang chub sems/ /mkha' mnyam byang chub rdo rje'i rdzas/ /mi bskyod bsten pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rgas shing zil gyis gnon pa 'grub/ /ces so/ /don gsum pa bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes gong du 'phel ba la/ spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis las/ spyir bstan pa ni/ bde gsal mi rtog skyon med gong 'phel na/ /dmigs pa gang rung sems bzung mchog tu bsngags/ /dang po dmigs yul ma gtad bsgoms pa yis/ /de rjes dmigs med ngang du lhan gyis 'gro/ /gnad 'di shin tu yang zab mchog yin pas/ /skal ldan rnams kyis dang du blang bar bya/ /mtshan bcas yin zhes spong ba blun po'i lam/ /nyams myong med pa'i lugs ngan dor bar bya/ /bde stong chen po'i dmigs rten thig le 'bar 'dzag
