/gsal stong gi dmigs rten rlung gi kha dog mi rtog gi rten nam mkha' dag pa rnams la ches cher ma yengs par sems gtad dus/ rtog pa gzhan rnams der nub la/ de yang de'i rdzas la yid la mi byed par lhan gyis bde gsal mi rtog ba'i ngang so so la gnas pa ni/ zab mo'i don gnad las skyes pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa gang yang rung cig la/ /yid ni ting nge 'dzin la gzhag /ci yang med cing bsgoms pa yis/ /phyi nas de yang rab tu spong*/ /zhes pa'i don to/ kha cig mtshan bcas des ci bya zer ba ni/ / gnad med la myong ba til shun tsam med pa ste yid brtan du mi rung bar shes par byos shig /bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum las/ bde ba'i bogs 'byin bstan pa ni/ khyad par bde dmigs bogs 'byin dam pa ni/ /'og rlung 'then la gsang ba'i gnas nyid nas/ /thig le yar thim spyi gtsug nyid du thim/ /gang yang dmigs med ngang du gzhag par bya/ /de rjes steng 'og kha sbyar rlung bzung la/ /snying gar sems gtad skye med ngang la gzhag /bde gsal spros bral ngang la gnas pa yin/ /'dir mchog gi rnal 'byor pa phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyor la/ thun mong gi rnal 'byor pa yid kyi rig ma bsten nas/ thig le gsang bar bab dus rlung drag tu 'then nas/ thig le ba thag lta bur yar 'dus te spyi bo'i haṃ la thim/ de yang mi dmigs par bzhag pa'i rjes la/ rlung kha sbyar bzung nas yid la mi byed pa'i ngang la glod pas/ bde stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes la gnas pa yin no/ /yid kyi rig ma ni/ saṃ pu ṭi las/ skye bo mi bsrun drung dag tu/ /rnal 'byor pa ni gnas pa'i tshe/ /bstan la smod pas 'jigs pa'i phyir/ /rang sems tsam la mos pa bya/ /zhes so/ /'di ni gnad cung zad bshad na/ rang nyid yi dam yab yum du bsgoms pa'i mdun du/ /mi'i bu mo shin tu mdzes pa cig bsams la chags pas yun ring bltas na/

/de rdo rje phag mor bskyed pa'i mkha' gsang byin gyi brlabs te snyoms par zhugs pas/ lte ba'i a las me 'bar te spyi gtsug gi haṃ zhu bas/ thig le rim gyis babs par bsam zhing*/ bsrub pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba bya/ 'og rlung 'then nas lus sgrims shing mdoms 'byed 'dzum mang du bya/ de nas thig le rim gyis mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rdo rje'i rtsa ba/ de nas rtse mor yum gyi ze'u 'bru la dkar lhag gis byung bas/ dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ dga' bral/ lhan cig skyes dga'i bar rim pas ngos bzung la/ thig le 'chor ba snyam byed pa'am/ 'phro gcod na 'og rlung sor bzhag steng rlung drag tu mnan/ yum gyis phaṭa kyis phul/ yab kyis hūm̐ gis drangs/ rdo rje'i bu gar phaṭa kyis dngas ma 'ub kyis drangs hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gyen du phul te/ thig le thams cad spyi gtsug tu drangs/ mthar yum yang bde ba'i ngo bor zhu nas drangs pa haṃ la bstims/ haṃ yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag nas/ 'dren dang 'grems la sogs pa bya'o/ /de dag gi dus su lus gnad dang dmigs pa'i chings bsdam pa ni/ bar bar seng ge rtsal sprugs la sogs pa/ dbab bzlog drang zhing dgram dang la bzla ba'i/ /'khrul 'khor dmigs gnad mthong ba brgyud bzhin bya/ /zhes mdor bzhag nas rgyas par bstan pa las/ dang po/ dbab pa 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya nyid dang ni/ / ro stod smad gsigs gnon pa lta bur bya/ /dmigs pa haṃ las byang sems drangs pa yis/ /gsang bar babs dus bde la dmigs pa gtad/ /seng ge rtsal sprugs ni lus sug bzhi btsugs nas sprugs te mjing pa dgye la 'og rlung 'then la kha bzhad de ha chung ngur 'don pa ste/ dbab bzlog dgram pa thams cad spyi la phan pa'i gnad yin no/ /khyad par du dbab pa ni/ skyil krung bcas pa'i mdun du yid kyi rig ma dang zhugs par dmigs la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang ro stod yar seng stod pa des ro smad chir chir dbab cing*/

haṃ las byang sems gsang bar babs pas bde ba rgyas pa la sems gzung ngo*/ /'dis ni thig le rtsa dmigs thams cad du khyad par dbab pa'o/ / bzlog pa de nas gyen du drangs pa ste/ lag gnyis mkhal khung rgya mtsho brag la sbyar/ /'og rlung 'then la lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ /mig sprin bzlog cing mgo sgril 'dar ba bzhin/ /dmigs pa thig le ba thag brgyus pa bzhin/ /gcig la gcig thim spyi gtsug bar du bsam/ /gsang bar thig le phab pa de gyen du bzlog pa ni/ drang por 'dug ste/ lag pa gnyis mkhal khung du bsnol/ gsum pa sgal tshigs la stongs kyis sbyar/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then/ lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ mig sprin gyen du bzlog /dbugs bsdams te mjing pa mar brdzangs pas mgo dar po che bskyod pa ltar 'dar te/ thig le ba thag brgyus pa lta bu gsang ba nas spyi gtsug tu je thim la haṃ gi bar du bsams pas dngas ma 'dren pa'o/ /de nas lus thams cad khyab par/ dgram pa gzhu 'gengs rkang lag rtsal sprugs bya/ /si zhes lce rtse so sbyar rlung phyir bus/ / lag pa gzhu 'gengs byas nas/ seng ge rtsal sbrugs de byas rjes/ skyil krung gis 'dug la/ si zhes lce rtse so sbyar/ rlung phyir drangs pas/ ba spu'i bar khyab par khrems shing*/ dmigs pa rtsa gnas thams cad thig les khyab par bsams pa'i skad cig la dran med stong par gzhag go /de nas/ la bzla gan rkyal rlung sems sos dal la/ gar yang mi rtog cir yang mi 'dzin par/ /rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i ngang la gzhag /'di yis gegs med bde chen byang chub 'grub/ /thig le khrems pa dang*/ gan rkyal khong glod nas rang babs sos dal gyi ngang la dran med brgyal bar gzhag go /'di ni bde stong ka dag tu la bzla ba zhes bya ba ste/ thig le'i gegs med chos nyid kyi dbyings zin/ don gyi rang yul rnyed pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas drang por 'dug la don de nyid la rgyun du bsgom par bya'o/

/de ma shes par rtag tu dbab bzlog dgram gsum la sbyangs kyang*/ rtsol ba can phye chad pa'i lam zhes bya ste/ gnas lugs don gyi nges pa 'di bas phyi ma la'ang mi rnyed pas/ gnad 'di rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i thabs kyi che ba zhes bya'o/ /don gnyis pa/ gsal ba rlung gi bogs 'byin dam pa yang*/ /'jam rtsub gcig gis gcig gi bogs 'byin la/ /khyad par nang bzung phyir bzung gcig gis gcig / dal 'jam phan tshun gnad dang bsre ba gces/ /grangs dang kha dog reg bya dbyibs la sogs/ /du ma'i thabs la bslab pa'ang gsungs mod kyi/ /'di ni gcig gis kun 'grub man ngag la/ /'di ltar bslab pa gnad kyi rgyal po yin/ /'jam rlung bsgoms pa'i rjes la rtsub rlung bzung na yon tan gsar du skye la/ rtsub rlung pas kyang 'jam rlung la'ang mtshungs so/ /rlung nad 'dzin pas phyir der bzung ba dang*/ phyir 'dzin pas nang du bag re bzung ba ni gnad dam pa'o/ /gzhan yang rlung khug pa'i grangs la ma yengs par sems gzung ba dang*/ 'byung ba lnga'i kha dog gi rlung la sems gzung ba dang*/ reg bya tsha grang la sems gzung ba dang*/ rlung gi dbyibs tha dad pa la sems gzung bas bogags 'byin pa sna tshogs su bshad kyang*/ /de kun dmigs pa 'dzin pa tsam las/ chos nyid la dngos su sbyor mi nus so/ /skabs 'dir gnad gcig gis rlung dbu ma'i nang du 'chings nas chos nyid yul med du 'char ba'i thabs bstan pa ni/ /lus gnad sngar bzhin khyad par mig mi 'gul/ /rlung ni kha sna gsum mnyam shin tu dal/ /tha mal rang grol ngang la lhod kyis klod/ /ses gnad gang du'ang mi gzung rang bzhin bya/ /de rjes gan rkyal rkang lag brgyang bya stai/ /ha zhes drag la sems ni mkha' dkyil gtad/ /yeng med spro bsdu bral bar lhan ner gzhag /rlung sems rang grol bde ba'i ngang gnas pas/ /gegs med yon tan 'char sgo dpag tu med/ / lus rnam snang gi chos bdun las/

rlung kha sna mnyam du rab tu dal zhing*/ sems rtog med du dar cig glod pa ni rlung grangs su gzhug pa'o/ /de tshe dbu mar bcings pas gang du'ang mi rtog pa'i tshe/ rlung sems ka dag tu la bzla ba'i phyir rkang lag brkyangs nas gan rkyal la nyal te/ mig nam mkhar gtad/ ha drag po gsum brjod nas rlung phyir bzung ste/ sems rang sor bzhag pas gang la'ang 'dzin rtog med pa'i ye shes chos nyid zad pa'i dgongs pa skad cig la 'char ba yin no/ /rdzogs pa chen po rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du lhun gyis grub pa zhes bya ste/ chos sku kun du bzang po'i go 'phang la reg pa'o/ /de ltar yun du bsgoms pa las yon tan gyi 'char tshul bstan pa ni/ lus yang rgyu ba med dang spros kun zhi/ /sems gsal rab tu dngas shing mngon shes 'char/ /rkang mgyog 'grub cing mdog snum ting 'dzin skye/ /rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa'i rtags rnams 'byung*/ /yang zab mchog gi gnad yin shin tu gsang*/ /lus shing bal ltar yang ba dang*/ dbugs rgyu ba m-i tshor ba dang*/ rnam rtog spros pa zhi ba dang*/ sems dngas pa dang*/ gsal ba dang*/ mngon shes phra mo 'char ba dang*/ rta ltar mgyogs pa dang*/ mdog snum zhing 'od dang ldan pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsar du skye ba dang*/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags bcu rnam dag mthong ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo*/ /don gsum pa/ mi rtog nam mkha' lta bu'i bogs 'byin yang*/ /lus sems khong glod dmigs pa rtse gcig bzung*/ /gcig la ma yengs ches cher bltas pa yis/ /rnam rtog gzhan rnams de yi ngang nub ste/ /dmigs rten de la rtog pa'ang rab zhi nas/ /snang la der 'dzin med pa'i stong pa 'char/ / lus rnam snang gi chos bdun las khyad par du lha sku la sogs pa cig la cer re bltas dus/ rtog pa gzhan thams cad lha skur nub pa dang*/ lha skur rtog pa'ang ngang gis zhi nas snang stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'char ro/

/ chings gal po che/ 'di ni gnad yin gzhan yang 'di ltar bslab/ /res 'ga' dmigs pa phyir bzung rlung bus la/ /phyi ru tsam gnas bzhag pas mi rtog skye/ /res 'ga' nang bzung stod smad gang rung du/ /dmigs rten cig la ma yengs tsan ne gzhag /res 'ga' rten med shes pa rang bzhin gzhag /yul snang der 'dzin med pa'i ngang la gnas/ /'di ni mi rtog chos sku'i dgongs pa ste/ /gnad la brten nas rang byung khong nas 'char/ /res 'ga' rlung phyir bzung nas sa rdo ri brag la sogs pa cer re bltas pas mi rtog pa skye'o/ /res 'ga' rlung nang du bzung nas 'khor lo bzhi rtsa yig gam 'od dam lha sku gang rung la sems gtad pas 'grub bo/ /res 'ga' rten med kyi shes pa 'dzin med du har re bzhag pas bar med mnyam pa'i ye shes skye'o/ /mjug bsdu ba ni/ bde gsal mi rtog spyi yi bogs 'byin ni/ / tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa dang*/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchog tu bsngags/ /'di ni mthar thug gnad kyi gdams pa ste/ /skal bzang thar pa 'dod pas dang du blang*/ de ltar bsod nams kyi las byas pas/ bsod nams ma yin pa rtogs pa'i phyir/ bsags sbyong lam gyi bogs 'byin du zab ste/ sangs rgyas mang byed kyi mdo las/ bsod nam bsags pa dag ni bsam pa 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /don gsum pa gnas lugs kyi lam ma nor bas thob pa'i rtogs pa bstan pa ni/ /de ltar bsgoms pas shar ba'i rtogs pa yang*/ ro mnyam gcig ste tha dad du ma med/ /phyogs gsum gcig tu 'du ba'i don sa dang*/ /chu bran tha dad rgya mtshor gcig pa ltar/ /bde gsal mi rtog thabs gsum gang bsgoms kyang*/ /sems nyid ma skyes nam mkha'i rang bzhin du/ /blo yi 'jug pa rab zhi thim pa na/ /yod med spros dang bral ba'i byang chub sems/ /'od gsal gshis kyi nyi ma khong nas 'char/ /grub gsal 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rtogs pa ste/

/mkha' mnyam bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin no/ /phyogs tha dad nas 'ongs kyang don sa gcig tu 'du ba ltar/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i thabs so so nas bsgoms kyang*/ /rtogs pa'i ngo bo rig stong zang ka rjen pa gcig tu skyel so gcig ste/ de'i ngo bo ni gang du'ang ma grub pa'i rig pa phyal ba bar med 'od gsal dag pa ste/ rang rig sgrib g.yogs med pa rang gsal ba'o/ /'di ni dus rtag par yod kyang bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa 'gas rig pa'i spyod yul/ 'di'i ngo bo ni rang gsal la yul med pa/ gting gsal rkyen la mi ltos pa/ ye gsal glo bur du ma byung ba'o/ /don 'di la 'od gsal ba'i ye shes zhes bya ste/ brgyad stong pa las/ sems la sems ma mchis te/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o zhes gsungs so/ /'od gsal de yang ji ltar zhe na/ de tshe rtse gcig dngas gsal rnyog med pa/ /zhi lhag yangs pa'i bsam gtan rgya mtsho la/ /phyogs bral 'dzin med gzugs brnyan rang bzhin med/ /chos kun rtogs pa'i ngo bo zung du 'brel/ /snang ba sgyu 'dra stong pa der 'dzin med/ /zung 'jug dbyer med dgongs klong yangs pa ni/ /gnad nas byung ba'i 'od gsal khong nas shar/ /rgya mtsho dngas pa la gzugs brnyan byung yang chu las gzhan du grub pa med cing*/ gzugs brnyan dang char pa chu gnyis gcig dang du mar med la/ snang la ngos gzung med pa ltar/ sems nyid dngas pa'i ngo bo ni sna tshogs kyi snang ba shar yang*/ yul snang gis sems la ma gos/ sems kyis yul snang la ma bzung*/ dbang shes la snang yang 'dzin pas ma bslad pas/ sgyu ma rang sa na gsal la/ blo rtse gcig rang gnas kyi zhi gnas dang*/ rang gsal zang ka'i lhag mthong gnyis ngo bo rdzas gcig tu gnas dus/ yul snang snang ba la/ stong pa sems kyis mi 'dzin pa'i phyir snang la rang bzhin med pa'i 'od gsal zhes bya'o/ /rnam nges las kyang*/ thams cad las ni sems bsus nas/

/nang gi bdag nyid g.yo med par/ /gnas na'ang mig gis gzugs dag ni/ /mthong ba'i blo de dbang skyes yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /su'i mthu las shar zhe na/ bla ma'i byin rlabs rang byung ye shes ni/ /tshig dang bsam brjod 'das tshe mthong ba ste/ /de lta bu nyid dus su mthong ba ni/ /dus gsum dus med snga phyi dbye bsal med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin yin dbu ma ste/ /spros dang sdug bsngal zhi byed phyag rgya che/ /snying po'i chos nyid rdzogs pa chen po ste/ /gdod ma'i zad pa gshis kyi gnas lugs nyid/ /'od gsal sems nyid rang byung ye shes yin/ /ming mang btags kyang don gyi ngo bo gcig /chos nyid smra bsam brjod 'das byang chub sems/ /'khor 'das gnyis med nam mkha' lta bu yin/ /bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis sems nyid 'od gsal ba'i ngo bo mthong ste/ do ha las/ bla mas smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa/ /lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra/ /zhes so/ / de yang smra bsam brjod pa las 'das pa nam mkha' ltar mthong ba'i dus der snga phyi ris med bsal bzhag las 'das par rtog pas 'ching ba kun las grol te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ / gzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /ces so/ /sems nyid gshis kyi don de mthong ba la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ dbu ma dang*/ zhi byed dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po la sogs ming ci btags kyang*/ don ngo bo gcig ste rig pa byang chub kyi sems kun byed nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /ji skad du/ /kun byed las/ kun byed nga yi rang bzhin gcig pu la/ /'khor gyi 'dod pa rnams kyis ming btags pa/ /la las byang chub sems su ming yang btags/ /la las nam mkha'i khams su ming yang btags/ /la las rang byung ye shes ming yang btags/ /la las chos kyi sku ru ming yang btags/

/ la las longs spyod rdzogs par ming yang btags/ /la las sprul pa'i sku ru ming yang btags/ /la las thams cad mkhyen par ming yang btags/ /la las rnam pa thams cad ming yang btags/ /la las ye shes bzhi dang gsum du btags/ /la las ye shes lnga ru ming yang btags/ /la las dbyings dang ye shes ming btags pa/ /rang byung byang chub sems ni gcig la btags/ /rang byung nga la mthong tshad smras pa yin/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ / rtogs pa blo 'das chen por don bsdu ba ni/ phyogs ris ma 'dzin grub mtha'i gzeb las 'das/ /blo bral gnyis med mnyam rdzogs chen po ste/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mtha' grol klong yangs su/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis yongs su shes par bya/ /gnas lugs mthong ba'i ngo bo ni theg pa dang grub mtha'i yid dpyod kyis mi rtogs te tshig dang tha snyad kyi yul las 'das pa'i phyir dang*/ /mos sgom don spyi yul las 'das te blo bral gnyis med nam mkha' ltar bsam brjod las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na ji ltar shes par bya zhe na/ kun byed las/ don 'di nges par rtogs 'dod na/ /dpe ni nam mkha' lta bur brtag

/don ni chos nyid skye ba med/ /rtogs na sems nyid 'gag pa med/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i chos nyid la/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dpe yis mtshon/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i don la 'gags bsdu bas nyams su len na/ rang sems bcos bslad med pa'i ngang der re dogs 'bad rtsol zhig pas rang gsal zang ka rjen par 'jog pa yin te/ de nyid las/ kye sems dpa' chen po rang sems grub 'dod na/ /'dod pa med pas grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ /rtog med mnyam pa nyid la gnas mi byed/ /blang dor med pa'i yul la rang bzhin gnas/ /g.yos pa med pa'i ngang la ngang gis gnas/ / sems ni ji bzhin pa yi ngo bo ste/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin nyid du grub/ /ji bzhin pa la 'chos par ma byed cig /ngo bo nyid las gzhan du ma bsgrubs shig /btsal na rgyal bas dbyings nas mi rnyed 'gyur/ /sngar byas zin pas da ni byed mi dgos/ /sngar grub zin pas da ni sgrub mi dgos/ /mi rtog cir mi dgongs la mnyam par zhog /kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang*/ /rang gi sems las gzhan du chos btsal med/ /ji bzhin pa la 'chos par byed ma myong*/ / ting 'dzin rnam par rtog pa sgom ma myong*/ /rang sems mi rtog pa yi sgrub pa yin/ /da ltar bzhugs dang slad kyis 'byon pa yang*/ /rtog med mnyam pa nyid kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /ces so/ /don bzhi pa 'bras bu bstan pa ni/ de dag mthar phyin 'bras bu'i rim pa ni/ /gnas skabs bde gsal mi rtog zung 'jug gis/ /spyan dang mngon shes yon tan dpag med cing*/ /mthar thug sku gsum yid bzhin rgyal chos 'grub/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /lam mthar gyis legs par bsgoms pa las/ gnas skabs su bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin grub pas spyan dang mngon shes la sogs pa 'grub cing mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub ste/

sku gsum ye shes dang bcas pas 'khor ba ji srid par sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /de yang chos sku nam mkha' 'dra ba'i ngang nas/ gzug sku nyi zla 'dra ba shar te don mdzad pa yang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sku gsum dag gi sangs rgyas kyis/ /don 'di rten dang bcas pa yin/ /zhes so/ /rgyud bla ma las/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*/ /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*/ / lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang*/ /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*/ / btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang*/ /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang*/ / byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*/ /bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs par ni/ / byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /mya ngan 'da' bar gshegs pa rnams/ / yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes pa dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gang gi srid pa ji srid par/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di/ /las ni rgyun mi 'chad pa yin/ / zhes gsungs so/ /dri med rdul bral byang chub snying po'i lam/ /zhi ba rab bzang phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rab dkar dam pa sngon du mdzad nas kyang*/ /sa steng rgyan gyur gong de'i rjes 'gro shog /chu gtsang me tog bung ba snyan sgrog cing*/ /rma bya gar byed pad+ma lhag ge ba/ /drang srong dka' thub dpal gyis mdzes pa der/ /gcig pu zhi ba'i gnam g.yogs 'dzin par shog /sdug bsngal yongs gang srid pa'i me 'obs las/ /ting 'dzin grub pa bsam gtan chu bsil gyis/ /ma lus 'gro ba zag med bder gyur te/ /zhi bde thar pa'i gnas su 'dren par shog /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta rnam dag las/ gang bsgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa bstan pa ste/ rdo rje'i gnas gsum pa'o/

/da ni bstan bcos yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don bstan pa las dge ba bsngo ba ni/ de ltar chos tshul zhi ba snying po'i don/ /zab cing rgya che bshad pa'i bsod nams des/ /'gro kun byang chub dam pa gnyis thob nas/ /yid bzhin 'phrin las 'byor pa mtha' yas shog /chos kyi tshul rmad du byung ba legs par bkod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 'byor pa mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i go 'phang thob par shog cig ces pa'o/ /gang gis gang du ji ltar bkod pa'i tshul brjod pa ni/ 'di ni rgyal sras dri med 'od zer gyis/ /rang gi nyams len gnad dril bcud bsdus te/ /phyi rabs don du gsal bar bshad pa ni/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma rgyal po'i chos kyi sras su gyur pa mang du thos pa'i blo gros dri ma med pa'i 'od zer mnga' bas/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad las/ man ngag gi gnad rang gis myong ba rnams bsdus te/ phyi rabs kyi don du ri'i rgyal po gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa'o/ /gzhan don brtson pa la gdams pa ni/ thar pa 'dod pa dag gis brtson byas shing*/ /yi ge 'di bzhin nyams su blang bar mdzod/ /gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis phun tshogs te/ /bde chen gling du myur du dga' bde byed/ /phyi rabs thar pa bsgrub pa dag gis yi ge 'di'i don bsgom pa la brtson par bya ste/ nyin mtshan du nyams su blangs pas myur du rang gzhan gyi don gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub nas bde chen byang chub mchog gi 'byor pa dam pas dga' bde byed pa'o/ /dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ brtson la byang chub 'di gnas kyi/ /mi brtson pa la gnas ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / mthar phyin pa gzhug gi don bstan zin to/ /de ltar legs bshad bsod nams sprin chen gyis/

/ma lus 'gro rgyud skye bo'i mkhar khyab ste/ /don gnyis phun tshogs phan bde'i char babs pas/ /mngon par byang chub 'byor ba mtha' yas shog /lam ngan nas ni nges par 'byung ba gang*/ /shing rta rnam dag rdo rje snying po'i don/ /zab cing rgya che dam pa 'dir zhugs te/ /'gro kun thar pa'i grong du phyin par shog /chos tshul 'di ni 'od stong nyin mor byed/ / lung rig man ngag dkyil 'khor bzang po ste/ /yid mkha'i mun pa ma lus sel ba dang*/ /mnyam du byang chub pad+mo rgyas byed yin/ /skye ba sngon rabs rnams su yang dang yang*/ /'di 'dra'i tshul la blo mig rab sbyangs pas/ / 'dir yang mdo rgyud man ngag snying po'i don/ /ma lus dbang 'byor zab don kun la mkhas/ /tshul khrims dri med dngas pa'i nam mkha' la/ /blo gros gtso bor stong ldan shar ba yis/ /sna tshogs klong chen pad+mo rab rgyas shing*/ / rang grol rab 'byams snang ba phyogs bcur shar/ /gang gi sngon gyi skye bo dam pa'i lugs/ /mi dbang yang dag phul gyi rjes 'gro ba/ /rang byung pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pa des/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /shing rta rnam dag rdo rje rtse mo'i srol/ /tshig don rnam bkra'i bkod pas nyer mdzes shing*/ /rnal grol thar lam bzhon pa mchog gyur 'dis/ / skal bzang skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta rnam dag ces bya ba/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gnas la mang du sbyangs ba'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (22) rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta rnam par dag pa/ - PAGE 240 -- PAGE 239 -- PAGE 199 -
